Mishneh Torah, First Fruits and other Gi:
Mitzvat ase lehaferish teruma min haissa lakkohen shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 20)</small> "reshit arisotechem challa tarimu teruma". vereshit zo en lah shiur min hattora afillu hifrish kisora patar et haissa. vehaose kol issato challa lo asa kelum ad sheyyeshayyer miktzato: 
Umiddivre sofrim shemmafrishin echad mearbaa veesrim min haissa kede sheyyihye bah kede mattana lakkohen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "titten lo "ten lo davar harauy litteno mattana. vehannachtom haose limkor bashshuk mafrish echad mishshemona vearbaim. lefi sheissato merubba yesh beshiur ze kede mattana: 
Haose issa lemishte beno af al pi shehu merubbe mafrish echad meesrim vearbaa. shello lechallek beissat baal habbayit. vehannachtom sheasa issa ketanna echad mearbaim ushemone. shello lechallek beissat hannachtom: 
Nitmet haissa beshogeg o beones mafrish echad mearbaim ushemona. veim timmeah bezadon mafrish echad michd kede shello yihye chote niskar. vechalla temea [mutteret] (lakkohen) lehassaka kitruma temea: 
En chayyavin bechalla min hattora ella beeretz yisrael bilvad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 19)</small> "vehaya baachalchem millechem haaretz" vegomer. uvizman shekkol yisrael sham shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 18)</small> "bevoachem" biat kullechem velo biat miktzatchem. lefichach challa bazzeman hazze afillu bime ezra beeretz yisrael enah ella middivrehem kemo shebbearnu bitruma: 
Perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz chayyavin bechalla. uferot haaretz sheyyatzu chutza laaretz peturin shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 18)</small> "asher ani mevi etchem shamma" shamma attem chayyavin ben al perot haaretz ben al perot chutza laaretz: 
Mafrishin challa bechutza laaretz middivre sofrim kede shello tishtakkach torat challa miyyisrael. veen meviin challot chutza laaretz laaretz keshem sheen meviin teruma uvikkurim mishsham. veim hevi mannichah ad erev happesach vetissaref kitruma: 
Shelosha dinin lechalla beshalosh aratzot. kol haaretz shehecheziku bah ole bavel ad keziv mafrishin bah challa achat kashshiur vehi neechelet lakkohanim. ushear eretz yisrael shehecheziku bah ole mitzrayim velo ole bavel shehi mikkeziv vead amana mafrishin bah shete challot haachat nisrefet vehaachat neechelet. umippene ma mafrishin bah shete challot mippene shehachalla harishona temea shehare lo nitkaddesha otah haaretz bime ezra. ukedushsha rishona batla mishsheggalu. vehoil vehi eretz yisrael mafrishin bah challa echad mearbaim ushemona vesorfin otah. umafrishin challa sheniyya venotnin otah lakkohen leachlah. kede shello yomru teruma tehora nisrefet shehare nisrefa harishona af al pi shello nitmea tuma yedua lakkol. vezo sheniyya en lah shiur ella kol sherotze mafrish mippene shehi middivrehem. vechol haaretz meamana velachutz ben besureya ben bishar haaratzot mafrishin shete challot. achat lisrefa kede shello yomru rainu teruma temea neechelet. veachat laachila kede shello tishtakkach torat challa miyyisrael. vehoil vezo vezo middivrehem mutav lerabbot banneechelet lefichach shel serefa en lah shiur ella kol shehu. veshel achila echad mimch. umutteret lezavim ulezavot veen tzarich lomar lishar temeim: 
Bazzeman hazze sheen sham issa tehora mippene tumat hammet mafrishin challa achat bechol eretz yisrael echad mimch vesorfin otah mippene shehi temea veyesh lah shem min hattora. umikkeziv ad amana mafrishin sheniyya lakkohen laachila veen lah shiur, keshehaya haddavar mikkodem: 
Challat chutza laaretz af al pi shehi temea hoil veikkar chiyyuvah middivrehem enah asura baachila ella al kohen shettuma yotza alav miggufo vehem baale kerayin vezavim vezavot veniddot veyoldot umetzorain. aval shear hattemeim bemagga shear hattumot afillu temee met muttarim leachlah. lefichach im haya sham kohen katan bechutza laaretz ben besureya ben bishar aratzot veratza lehaferish challa achat mafrish echad mimch. veneechelet lekatan sheadayin lo raa keri o liktanna sheadayin lo raata nidda. veeno tzarich lehaferish sheniyya: 
Vechen im haya sham kohen gadol shettaval mishshichvat zaro o mizzivato af al pi shello heeriv shimsho veaf al pi shehu teme met hare ze muttar leechol hachalla harishona veeno tzarich lehaferish sheniyya bechutza laaretz. kol hammafrish challa mevarech techilla asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehaferish challa ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. ucheshem shemmevarech al hattehora kach mevarech al hattemea. lefichach en haish erom mafrish challa sheeno yachol levarech. aval haishsha haaruma sheyyashva vechol paneha tuchot bakkarka mevarechet umafreshet challa: 
Hannidda vechayyotze bah mevarechet umafreshet challat chutza laaretz sheenah muzheret al maggaah ella al achilatah. veim haya sham kohen katan o kohen shettaval shehi mutteret lo laachila kemo shebbearnu hare ze muttar leachlah im hazzar al shulchan echad lefi sheenah medammaat. vaafillu nitarva shave beshave. venotnin otah lechohen am haaretz mippene shehi temea baavir eretz haammim [veen bah mishshum kohen hammesayyea bemattenotav shehu asur. veim ratza leechol techilla] veachar kach yafrish hachalla bechutz laaretz muttar sheen ikkarah ella middivrehem: 
Hachalla nikret teruma lefichach enah nittelet ella min hammukkaf kitruma. veenah nittelet min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla: 
Vechol sheamarnu bitruma lo yitrom veim taram enah teruma kach bechalla. vechol sheamarnu bitruma lo yitrom mizze al ze kach bechalla. vechol sheeno ochel teruma eno ochel challa. vechol haochel teruma ochel challa: 
Hassuma vehashshikkor mafrishin challa lechattechilla sheen beissa ra veyafe kede sheyyechavvenu veyafrishu min hayyafe:
Halokeach min hannachtom chayyav bechalla. umafrish min hachamma al hatztzonenet umin hatztzonenet al hachamma afillu middefusin harebe:

En chayyavin bechalla ella chamishsha mine tevua bilvad vehem hachittin vehasseorim vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual vehashshifon shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 19)</small> "baachalchem millechem haaretz". veen karuy lechem ella pat hannaaset meellu aval haose pat orez o dochan vechayyotze bahen min hakkitniyyot enan chayyavin bechalla kelal:

Halleket vehashshichcha vehappea vehahefker utevua shello hevia shelish af al pi shehen peturin min hatteruma chayyavin aleha bechalla. vechen maaser rishon shehikdimo bashshibbolim shennittela terumato af al pi sheyyesh bo chelek teruma gedola umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu umotar haomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim kesheyyippadu kol otan hammotarot hakkol chayyavin bechalla:
Issa shel maaser sheni birushalayim veissat sheviit usefek medumma chayyavin bechalla. aval hamedumma patur min hachalla:
Challot toda urekike nazir asaan leatzmo peturin min hachalla mippene shehen kodesh. lemachran bashshuk linzirim ulemakrive toda chayyavin bechalla. lefi shebbedato sheim lo timmacher yochlenna:
Issat hashshuttafin vehaose issa lerabbim chayyevet bechalla:

Haose issa min hattevel. ben shehikdim challa litruma ben shehikdim teruma lechalla ma sheasa asuy. veim hifrish hachalla techilla lo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma uterumat maaser. veim hifrish techilla teruma lo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha challa:
Haose issa lehaachil happat shellah livhema o lechayya petura. issat hakkelavim bizman sheharoim ochlin mimmenna chayyevet bechalla. issat haakkum petura:
Hayu yisrael veakkum shuttafin baissa im haya bechelek yisrael shiur issa hachayyevet bechalla hare zo chayyevet bechalla:

Akkum shehifrish challa afillu beeretz yisrael enah challa. ella modiin oto sheeno tzarich veteachel lezar. velamma lo chashashnu lah shemma issa shel yisrael hi vetala otah beyad akkum uchede lefatrah. sheim yirtze yisrael yiftor atzmo veyaase yisrael issato pachot mishshiur challa:

Hamearev kemach chittin vekemach orez veasa mehen issa im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bechalla veim lav petura. afillu haya hasseor chittim letoch issat orez. im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bechalla veim lav petura:

Issa shennillosha beyayin o shemen o devash o mayim rotchim o shennatan letochah tavlin o hirtiach hammayim vehishlich hakkemach letocho velasho. im afaah ben betannur ben bekarka ben al hammachavat vehammarcheshet. ben shehidbik et habbatzek bemachavat uvemarcheshet veachar kach hirtichan baesh millematta ad shenneefet happat. ben shehirtichah veachar kach hidbik habbatzek. kol ellu chayyavin bechalla. aval haose issa leyabbeshah bachamma bilvad o levashshelah bikdera hare hi petura min hachalla sheen maase chamma lechem ben shellashah bemayim ben shellashah bishar mashkin. vechen kali shellashin oto bemayim o bidvash veochlin oto belo afiyya patur sheen chayyevet ella issa shessofah leheafot lechem lemaachal adam:
Issa shellashah techilla laasotah maase chamma vehishlimah laasotah pat. o shehitchil bah leefot pat vehishlimah laasot maase chamma. vechen kali shellasho leefoto pat chayyavin bechalla:
Lechem heasuy lechutach maaseha mochichin aleha. asaah keachin chayyevet bechalla. asaah kelimmudin petura min hachalla:

Kamma shiur haissa shechayyevet bechalla. melo haomer kemach ben meechad mechamishsha minim ben mechamishtan kullam mitztarfin leshiur. vechamma hu shiur haomer shene kabbin pachot chomesh. vehakkav arbaa login. vehallog arba reviiyyot veharviit etzbaayim al etzbaayim berum etzbaayim vachatzi etzba vechomesh etzba. vechol haetzbaot hem rochav gudal etzbaot shel yad. nimtzeta lamed shehammidda sheyyesh bah eser etzbaot al eser etzbaot berum shalosh etzbaot uteshia etzba bekeruv hu haomer. vechen midda sheyyesh bah sheva etzbaot pachot shene teshie etzba al sheva etzbaot pachot shene teshie etzba berum sheva etzbaot pachot shene teshie etzba hi middat haomer. ushete hammiddot keechad hem olim. vechamma mechila midda zo kemo arbaim veshalosh betzim benoniyyot vechomesh betza vehem mishkal shishsha ushemonim selaim ushene shelishe sela mikkemach hachittim shebbemitzrayim. shehem mishkal chamesh meot veesrim zuz mizzuze mitzrayim bazzeman hazze. umidda shemmechila kammishkal hazze mikkemach hachittim hazze bah moddin lechalla bechol makom:

Asur leadam laasot issato pachot pachot mikkashshiur kede lefatrah min hachalla. vehammafrish challa meissa shehi pechuta mikkashshiur lo asa kelum vahare hi chullin keshehayta. asa issa pechuta mikkashshiur vaafaah venatan happat lassal. vechazar veafa pat acheret venatan lassal im nitkabbetz bassal shiur challa hassal metzarfan lechalla umafresh hachalla min happat. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 19)</small> "vehaya baachalchem millechem haaretz" melammed shehu mafrish min haafuy. veen hattannur metzarfan lechalla:

Hayu hakkikkarot noshchot zo bezo venitkabbetz min hakkol shiur challa chayyavin bechalla af al pi sheenan bassal. afa meat meat vekibbetz hakkol al luach sheen lo toch hare ze safek. veim challa shel divrehem hi eno chayyav lehaferish ad sheyyetzaref oto keli sheyyesh lo toch:

Kemach shello rikkedo ella lasho bassubbin shello. hoil veyesh bechol hakkemach omer chayyav bechalla. aval im natal hammursan min hakkemach vechazar vehishlim shiur haissa bammursan shehecheziro lakkemach eno chayyav bechalla:
Nachtom sheasa issa laasotah seor lechallekah chayyevet bechalla. sheim lo timmacher yaasenna pat. aval haose issa lechallekah batzek petura:
Nashim shennatnu kemach lenachtom laasot lahem seor. im en beshel achat mehen kashshiur af al pi sheyyesh bichlalan kashshiur petura:

Shete issot sheyyesh bishtehen shiur hachayyav bechalla veen beachat mehen kashshiur venagu zo bezo venashchu zo et zo im hayu shel shenayim afillu hen mimmin echad peturin min hachalla. shessetam shenayim makpidin. veim yadua sheenan makpidin al eruv haissot hare ellu mitztarfot: 
Hayu shetehen shel ish echad im hayu mimmin echad mitztarfin vechayyavot bechalla veim mishshene minin hayu en mitztarfin. shessetam echad eno makpid. veim haya makpid shello tigga issa zo bezo velo titarev immah afillu hayu mimmin echad en mitztarfot: 
Vechetzad mitztarfot. im hayu shel echad mimmin echad issat hachittim shennaga beissat hakkussemin mitztarfot. naga bishar hamminin en mitztarfot. vechen issat seorin shennaga beissat hakkussemin o shibbolet shual o shifon vechen issat kusmin veshel shibbolet shual veshel shifon shennaga kol achat mishshelashtan bachavertah hare ellu mitztarfot: 
Issat chadash enah mitztarefet leshel yashan af al pi shehen mimmin echad. kede shello yomru tormin min hechadash al hayyashan. velo yitrom meemtza shetehen ella yavi issa acheret chadash o yashan veyitztaref lahem lehashelim hashshiur. bamme devarim emurim beissa shennaga beissa acheret. aval habbolel kemach chameshet hamminin veose mehem issa achat hare chamishshetan mitztarfin leshiur issat challa kemo shebbearnu: 
Issa shehi pechuta mikkashshiur mikkan. veissa pechuta mikkashshiur mikkan. veissa sheenah chayyevet bechalla beemtza kegon issat orez o issat teruma o medumma o issat akkum. af al pi shennogot zo bazo enan mitztarfot shehare davar happatur min hachalla mavdil baemtza: 
Haya baemtza issa shehurema challatah mitztarfot shehaissa shebbenehen kevar hayta mechuyyevet bechalla. vechen im haya benehen issat hekdesh mitztarfot mippene sherauy lifdotah vetitchayyev bechalla. vechen im hayta benehen issat min acher o issat ish acher o issat chadash hare shete haissot shebbatztzedadin mitztarfot lechalla: 
Shete issot shekkol achat mehen pechuta mikkashshiur shehifrish challa mizzo vechalla mizzo vechazru venagu zo bazo vahare bishtehem kashshiur chayyavin lehaferish mehen challa shehachallot harishonot enan kelum: 
Shene akkum sheasu issa kashshiur vechillekuha veachar kach nitgayyeru. vehosif kol echad al chelko achar shennitgayyer ad shehishlimu lashshiur hare zo chayyevet. shello hayta lah sheat chova keshehayu akkum shehare pachot mikkashshiur haya beyad kol echad mehen: 
Aval shene yisreelim sheasu kach vechazar kol echad achar shechilleku vehosif al chelko ad shehishlimo lashshiur hare zo petura. shekkevar hayta lah sheat chova vehen hayu peturin beotah shaa mippene sheasauha lechallek: 
Hayta haissa beyad haakkum vehayyisrael beshuttafut vechilleku. veachar kach nitgayyer haakkum vehosif hagger al shello [veyisrael al shello] ad shehishlim kol echad issato lashshiur shel yisrael chayyevet veshel akkum petura: 
Hannotel seor meissa shello hurema challatah unetano letoch issa shehurema challatah hare ze mevi issa sheniyya sheyyihye bah im seor ze shiur issa shechayyevet bechalla venotnah betoch haissa shehurema challatah. umafresh min haissa hashsheniyya shiur challa aleha veal hasseor kede sheyyittol min hammukkaf. veim en lo issa sheniyya naaset zo kullah tevel umafrish challa al hakkol shehattevel bemino oser bechol shehu: 
Issa hattevula lechalla enah kechalla. vahare hi kechullin leinyan hattuma. sheen hashsheni ose shelishi bechullin kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. umuttar ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael. lefichach shete issot achat temea veachat tehora notel kede challat shetehem meissa shello hurema challatah venotno baemtza samuch laissa hattehora umoshech min hattemea lattehora kede betza kede litrom min hammukkaf: 
Ose adam issa tehora veeno mafrish challatah umannichah o manniach mikketzatah lihyot mafrish aleha veholech challot shel issot acherot. vaafilu nitmeu haissot ad shettease haissa shehinniach kullah challa veyittenenna lakkohen. vehu shello tippasel meochel adam. aval mishshettisrach eno mafrish aleha. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu otam haissot shemmafrish alehen safek im hurema challa mehen o lo hurema shechallat demay nittelet min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla veshello min hammukkaf:

Hammafrish challato kemach enah challa vegezel beyad kohen. ushear haissa chayyevet bechalla. veoto hakkemach shehifrish leshem challa im yesh bo omer veosehu issa hare ze mafrish mimmennu challa kishar kol kemach chullin: 
Ematay mafrishin challa. kesheyyitten et hammayim veyitarev hakkemach bemayim mafrish hachalla mittechillat davar shennillosh shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 20)</small> "reshit arisotechem". vehu shello yishshaer sham baareva kemach shello nitarev bammayim shiur omer. veim amar hare ze challa al haissa veal hasseor veal hakkemach shennishtayyer velichshettease kullah issa achat titkaddesh zo shebbeyado leshem challa hare ze muttar: 
Hinniach haissa ad shellash hakkol veervah veachar kach hifrish en bechach kelum. veim lo hifrish hachalla batzek ella afa hakkol hare ze mafrish min happat kemo shebbearnu: 
Meematay titchayyev haissa bechalla mishshettiggalgel bechittim veyitarev hakkemach bemayim. o shettittamtem bisorim vetease kullah guf echad. veochlin aray min haissa ad shettitgalgel bechittim vetittamtem bisorim. vehakkussemin kechittim veshibbolet shual vehashshifon kisorim: 
Nitgalgela bechittim venittamtema bisorim haochel mimmenna kodem haferashat challa chayyav mita mippene shehi tevel. lefichach im hayta haissa chayyevet bechalla min hattora haochel mimmenna loke kechol ochel tevel. veim hayta chayyevet middivrehem makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Issa shennidmea ad shello titgalgel petura. mishshettiggalgel chayyevet. vechen hammakdish issato o hammafkir otah kodem shennitgalgela ufedaah o zacha bah veachar kach gilgelah o hikdishah o hifkir otah achar shennitgalgela ufedaah o zacha bah hare zo chayyevet bechalla: 
Hikdishah kodem shettitgalgel venitgalgela beyad hahekdesh veachar kach pedaah petura shebbishat chovatah hayta petura: 
Vechen akkum shennatan leyisrael laasot lo issa unetanah lo bemattana ad shello gilgelah chayyevet umeshsheggilgelah petura: 
Ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo issa. nitgalgela ad shello nitgayyer petura. veim mishshennitgayyer chayyevet. veim safek chayyevet bechalla lefi shehu avon mita. vezar sheachal challat safek zo vechayyotze bah en chayyav aleha chomesh: 
Issa shennolad bah sefek tuma kodem shettitgalgel yaasenna betuma lefi shemmuttar letamme chullin shebbeeretz yisrael vetissaref challatah. nolad lah achar shennitgalgela sefek tuma shevvaddaah metamme et hachullin min hattora yigmerenna betohora. shekkol shevvaddaah metamme et hachullin gazru al sefeko bechullin hattevulim lechalla shello yetammeu otan hoil venitbelu lechalla. vetihye hachalla teluya lo neechelet velo nisrefet: 
Lo yaase adam issato betuma lechattechilla ella yizzaher veyishtaddel veyithar hu vechelav kede lehaferish challa tehora. haya beno uven hammayim yeter al arbaa milin yaasenna betuma veyafrish challa temea: 
En osim challat am haaretz betohora. aval osim issat chullin betohora. ketzad. megabbel haissa ze hechaver umafresh mimmenna kede challatah umannichah bichle gelalim o kele avanim o bichle adama sheen mekabbelin tuma uchesheyyavo am haaretz notel et shetehen et haissa veet hachalla veomrim lo hizzaher shello tigga bachalla shemma tachzor letivlah. umippene ma hittiru lo ze mishshum kede chayyav shel gabbal: 
Eshet chaver merakkedet uvoreret im eshet am haaretz. aval mishshettattil mayim baissa lo tesayyea otah mippene shehi osa issatah betuma. vechen hannachtom sheose betuma lo lashin velo orchin immo sheen machazikin yede ovre avera ella molichin immo pat lefalter: 
Hallokeach minnachtom am haaretz besureya veamar lo hifrashti challa eno tzarich lehaferish challa missafek. keshem shello nechshedu kol yisrael baaretz al teruma gedola kach lo nechshedu besureya al hachalla: 
Hallokeach bechutza laaretz min hannachtom tzarich lehaferish challa missafek. aval hallokeach mibbaal habbayit veen tzarich lomar hammitareach etzlo eno tzarich lehaferish challa missafek:

Mitzvat ase litten kol zoveach behema tehora lakkohen hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 3)</small> "veze yihye mishpat hakkohanim". veellu hem hannikraim bechol makom mattanot. umitzva zo noheget tamid ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit. uvechol makom ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz. uvechullin aval lo bemukdashin: 
Kol hakkadashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin bemattanot. veim kadam mum over lehekdeshan o shehikdishan temimim veachar kach nolad bahem mum venifdu hare ellu peturin min hammattanot: 
Sefek bechor chayyav bemattanot mikkol tzad. sheim bechor hu kullo lakkohen veim eno bechor mattenotav lakkohen. veim nistappek bishnayim velakach hakkohen haechad missafek hare hashsheni patur min hammattanot. asauhu kemi shezzacha bo hakkohen unetano bemumo livalav. aval sefek maaser patur mikkol makom shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Behemat kadashim shennifsela bemumah veenah chayyevet bemattanot shennitarva bivhemot acherot afillu achat bemea bizman shekkol behema mehen leacher kullan peturin. shekkol echad veechad safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. haya echad hu hashshochet et kullam poter mattenot achat mehen bilvad: 
En chayyav bemattanot ella behema tehora bilvad shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 3)</small> "im shor im se". kilayim habba mikkeves veez chayyav bemattanot. vehakkevi af al pi shehu safek mafrishin mimmennu kol hammattanot. tzevi habba al haez veyalda havvalad chayyav bachatzi mattanot shenneemar im se afillu miktzat se. tayish habba al hatztzeviyya havvalad patur min hammattanot: 
Echad hashshochet laachilat akkum o laachilat kelavim o lirfua chayyav bemattanot: 
Behemat shuttafin chayyevet shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 3)</small> "zovche hazzevach": 
Hallokeach behema mipperot sheviit chayyav bemattanot. kohanim uleviyyim peturim min hammattanot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 3)</small> "meet haam" vesafek hem haleviyyim im hem bichlal haam o lo. lefichach en notlin mehem veim natal hakkohen lo yachzir: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshochet leatzmo. aval kohen tabbach sheshshochet umocher bashshuk mamtinin lo shetayim veshalosh shabbatot. mikkan veelach motziin mimmennu mattanot venotnin otam lechohanim acherim. veim kava bet mitbachayim limkor en mamtinin lo ella motziin mimmennu miyyad. veim nimna millitten menaddin oto ad sheyyitten: 
Hashshochet leakkum ulechohen patur min hammattanot. vehammishtattef im hakkohen tzarich sheyyirshom chelko kede sheyyanniach hammattanot bechelek hakkohen. sheim lo tziyyen chelko chayyav bemattanot mippene sheen hakkol yodin shehakkohen shuttaf lo. lefichach im haya hakkohen omed immo bammitbachayim venose venoten immo eno tzarich lirshom. vehammishtattef im haakkum eno tzarich lirshom shessetam akkum marbe devarim umodia lakkol shehu shuttaf veaf al pi sheeno immo bishat mechira: 
Hitna hakkohen immo shehu shuttaf chutz min hammattanot hare hammattanot lakkohen. kevan sheamar lo chutz hare shiyyer lo hakkohen chelek bammattanot ulefichach hem shello. aval im amar lo hakkohen al menat shehammattanot shelli hare hammattanot shel yisrael ze venotnan lechol kohen sheyyirtze. af al pi shehitna immo shehen shello lo niftar min hammattanot. shehaomer al menat lo shiyyer lo beatzman shel mattanot kelum hoil velo shiyyer lo bahen shuttafut lo kenaan bitnay ze: 
Haya hakkohen shuttaf barosh patur min hallechi. shuttaf bayyad patur min hazzeroa. shuttaf bivne meayim patur min hakkeva. amar lo hakkohen hare habbehema kullah shelli veharosh shellecha chayyav bilchi. shehaddavar hachayyav hare hu shel yisrael: 
Ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo behema shechuta. im nishchata ad shello nitgayyer patur. veim achar shennitgayyer chayyav. veim safek patur vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Behema shello huremu mattenoteha muttar leechol mimmenna sheenah doma letevel shehare mattenot kehunna muvdalin vehammattanot atzman asur leyisrael leachlan ella birshut kohen. avar vaachalan o hizzikan o mecharan eno chayyav leshallem. mippene shehu mamon sheen lo tovea yadua. vehakkone otam af al pi sheeno rashshay hare ze muttar leachlan mippene shemmattenot kehunna nigzalot: 
Amar lattabbach mechor li bene meeha shel para vehayu bah mattanot notnan lakkohen veeno menakke lo min haddamim. lekacham mimmennu bemishkal notnam lakkohen umenakke lattabbach min haddamim: 
Hameshalleach basar lachavero vehayu bah mattanot eno choshesh shemma avar ze ugezalan. makom sheen bo kohen maale hammattanot bedamim veochlan mippene hefsed kohen veyitten haddamim lechol kohen sheyyirtze: 
Harotze litten hammattanot lechohen echad noten. veim ratza lachlok otan lo yitten chatzi keva laechad o chatzi zeroa ella zeroa laechad vekeva laechad ulechayayim lishnayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "titten lo" sheyyihye bah kede mattana. veim hayu shel shor cholek otan chatichot vehu sheyyihye bechol chaticha kede mattana: 
E zehu hazzeroa. zeroa shel yamin min happerek shel arkubba ad kaf shel yado shehen shene evarim ze meore baze. vehallechayayim min happerek shel lechi vead pika shel gargeret tabbaat gedola im hallashon shebbenehen hakkol lakkohen: 
En molgin otan veen mafshitin otan ella yittenu lo beoran uvetzimran. vehakkeva bachelev shealeha uvachelev shebbetochah. uchevar nahagu hakkohanim lehanniach chelev hakkeva labbealim: 
Hakkohenet ochelet hammattanot af al pi shehi nesua leyisrael mippene sheen bahen kedushsha. velo od ella habbaal ochel mattanot biglal ishto. aval chalala enah ochelet. sheen chalalim bichlal kohanim. veim ratza hakkohen limkor hammattanot o littenan bemattana afillu leakkum o lehaachilam lichlavim maachilam sheen bahen kedushsha kelal: 
Kohen shehayu lo chaverim shennotnim lo hammattanot im ratza lezakkot bahen leyisrael chavero hare ze mezakke lo. veaf al pi shello bau leyado. veyihyu otam hachaverim zovchim venotnin hammattanot leze hayyisrael shezzacha bahen. vehu sheyyihye hayyisrael ze bedochak veen lo liknot basar. veyihye hakkohen shezzacha lo chavero. aval im haya hakkohen shammasho shel yisrael ze o sechiro o lekito eno mezakke lo ad sheyyavou leyado shemma yezakke beal karcho: 
Lo yachtof hakkohen hammattanot velo yishal befiv ella im ken notnin lo bechavod notel. uvizman shehem rabbim bevet hammitbachayim hatztzenuim moshchin yedehem vehaggargeranim notlin. veim haya kohen tzanua veen makkirin oto shehu kohen hare ze notel kede sheyyivvada lakkol shehu kohen. veen hakkohanim ochlin hammattanot ella tzali bechardal shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 29)</small> "lemashcha" kederech sheochlim hammelachim:

Mitzvat ase litten lakkohen reshit haggez shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "vereshit gez tzoncha titten lo". uleviyyim bichlal yisrael bemitzva zo. veen lereshit haggez zo shiur min hattora. umiddivre sofrim shello yifchot meechad mishshishshim. veenah noheget ella baaretz ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit kereshit haddagan. venoheg bechullin aval lo bemukdashin: 
Ketzad. hare shehikdish behemot levedek habbayit ugezazan yachol yihye chayyav lifdot velitten lakkohen. o hikdish behema chutz miggizzatah yachol yihye chayyav bereshit haggez. talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "tzoncha". en ellu tzono: 
Kol hakodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin bereshit haggez. aval im kadam hekdeshan et muman o shekkadam mum over lehekdeshan veachar kach nolad lahen mum kavua venifdu peturim mereshit haggez: 
En chayyavin bereshit haggez ella hakkevasim bilvad. zecharim kinkevot shehatztzemer shellahen hu harauy livgadim. haya tzimran kashe veeno rauy lilvisha peturin mereshit haggez. sheen mattana zo lakkohen ella kede lilbosh mimmenna: 
Kevan shezzikka lo hakkadosh baruch hu bitrumot shehen lachmo veyeno. vezikka lo bemattenot behema vekadshe mikdash shehabbasar shello. zikka lo bereshit haggez lilvusho. uvegezel hagger vehacharamim usede achuzza ufidyon bechorot lehotzaotav ushear tzerachav. shehare en lo chelek benachala uvabbizza: 
Haya hatztzemer shellahen adom o shachor o shachum chayyavot bereshit haggez. aval im gazaz hatztzemer utzevao kodem sheyyitten niftar mereshit haggez. hilbino kodem sheyyitten chayyav lehaferish achar shellibbeno. hattolesh tzemer rechelim beyado velo gazaz chayyav bereshit haggez: 
Reshit haggez noheg bechilayim uvichvi uvitrefa. aval haggozez et hammeta patur: 
Hammafrish reshit haggez veavad chayyav beacharayutan ad sheyyitten lakkohen. haomer kol gizzotay reshit devarav kayyamin: 
Hallokeach gez tzono shel akkum achar sheggezazan haakkum patur mereshit haggez. lakach hatztzon legizzatan chayyav af al pi sheggadla haggizza birshut haakkum. veaf al pi shechozrin hatztzon leakkum achar geziza. hoil vehaggozez yisrael vehaggezizot shello chayyav sheen hachiyyuv ella bishat haggizza: 
Hallokeach gez tzono shel chavero im shiyyer hammocher meat mitztzono lehiggazez hammocher chayyav lehaferish min hammeshoar al hakkol. veaf al pi shello hitchil hammocher ligzoz. chazaka en adam mocher mattenot kehunna. veim lo shiyyer kelum hallokeach chayyav lehaferish: 
Hayu shene mine gizza kegon gizza levana vegizza shechuma o gizzat zecharim vegizzat nekevot. umachar min ze vehinniach hammin haacher. ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo. [ze noten leatzmo] al ma shellakach veze noten leatzmo al ma sheshshiyyer: 
Ger shennitgayyer vehayu lo gizzot veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyer nigzezu o mishshennitgayyer hare ze patur. vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Kamma tzon yihye lo veyihyu chayyavot bereshit haggez. en pachot mechamesh. vehu sheyyihye baggizza shellahen en pachot mimmishkal shishshim sela. vetihye gizzat kol achat mechamishshetan en pachot mimmishkal 12 sela. hayta achat mehem gozezet pachot miv sela af al pi shechamishshetan gozzot shishshim sela o yeter hare ellu peturin mereshit haggez: 
Hashshuttafin chayyavin bereshit haggez. vehu sheyyihye bechelek kol echad mehen kashshiur. aval chamesh tzon bilvad shel shene shuttafin peturin: 
Reshit haggez mitzvatah battechilla veim hifrish ben baemtza ben bassof yatza. hayu lo chamesh tzon vegazaz achat mehen bilvad umachar gizzatah. veachar kach gozez sheniyya umachar gizzatah. veachar kach gozez shelishit umachar gizzatah. hakkol mitztarfot lereshit haggez. vechayyav afillu leachar kamma shanim. veyesh lo lehaferish min hechadash al hayyashan umizze al ze. aval im hayta rachel achat ugezazah vehinniach gizzatah veachar kach kana sheniyya ugezazah vehinniach gizzatah enan mitztarfot: 
Mi shehayu lo gizzot rabbot shel reshit haggez verotze lechallek lakkohanim. lo yitten lechol echad veechad pachot mimmishkal chamesh selaim melubban kede beged katan. lo sheyyelabbeno veachar kach yitten lo ella yitten lo mitztzemer haggizza keshehu tzoi. kede sheyyihye bo achar hallibbun chamesh selaim o yeter shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 4)</small> "titten lo" sheyyihye bo kede mattana hammoelet: 
Reshit haggez chullin lechol davar. lefichach ani omer shennotnim oto lechohenet af al pi shehi nesua leyisrael kemattenot behema. veyerae li sheddin shenehen echad hu:

Mitzvat ase lifdot kol ish miyyisrael beno shehu bechor leimmo hayyisreelit shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 19)</small> "kol peter rechem li". veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "ach pado tifde et bechor haadam": 
Veen haishsha chayyevet lifdot et benah. shehachayyav lifdot et atzmo hu shechayyav lifdot et beno. avar haav velo padahu kesheyyigdal yifde et atzmo: 
Haya hu lifdot uveno lifdot yifde atzmo techilla veachar kach beno. veim en lo ella kede pidyon echad yifde atzmo: 
Haya beno lifdot vehiggia et laalot laregel veen lo kede laze velaze. pode et beno veachar kach ole laregel shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "kl bechor banecha tifde" veachar kach <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "velo yerau fanay rekam": 
Happode et beno mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al pidyon habben. vechozer umevarech shehecheyaynu. veachar kach noten happidyon lakkohen. veim pada atzmo mevarech lifdot habbechor umevarech shehecheyaynu: 
Mitzva zo noheget bechol makom uvechol zeman. uvechamma podehu bechamesh selaim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 16)</small> "ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde". ben bechesef ben bishve kesef min hammittaltelin sheggufan mamon keinyan hashshekalim. lefichach en podin bekarkaot velo baavadim mippene shehen kekarkaot velo bishtarot lefi sheen gufan mamon. veim padahu bahen eno paduy: 
Katav haav lakkohen shehu chayyav lo chamishsha selaim chayyav litten lo uveno eno paduy. natan lo keli sheeno shave bashshuk chamishsha selaim vekibbelo hakkohen bachamishsha selaim hare beno paduy. natan chamishsha selaim laasara kohanim ben bevat achat ben baze achar ze yatza: 
Ratza hakkohen lehachezir lo happidyon machzir. velo yitten lo hu vedato sheyyachzir. veim asa ken vehechzir lo en beno paduy ad sheyyigmor belibbo litten lo mattana gemura. veim ratza hakkohen achar kach lehachezir yachzir. vechen im peresh venatan lo al menat lehachezir hare beno paduy: 
Kohanim uleviyyim peturim mippidyon habben mikkal vachomer. im patru shel yisrael bammidbar din hu sheyyifteru atzman: 
Yisrael habba min hakkohenet umin halleviyya patur. sheen haddavar taluy baav ella baem shenneemar peter rechem beyisrael: 
Leviyya hameubberet meakkum benah patur. vechohenet hameubberet meakkum benah chayyav shehare nifsela immo min hakkehunna bivilat haakkum: 
Kohen shennolad lo ben chalal. met haav betoch sheloshim yom habben chayyav lifdot et atzmo. shello zacha haav befidyono. met achar sheloshim yom eno chayyav habben lifdot et atzmo. shehare zacha haav befidyono: 
Hashshifcha shennishtachrera vechutit shennitgayyera keshehen meubbarot veyaldu. af al pi shehorato shello bikdushsha hoil venolad bikdushsha chayyav. shenneemar peter rechem beyisrael vahare peter verechem beyisrael. en yadua im kodem shennitgayyera yalda o achar shennitgayyera yalda hammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Hakkutit vehashshifcha sheyyaldu veachar kach nitgayyeru venishtachreru veyaldu valad acher hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 3 12)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "peter rechem" veen ze peter rechem. vechen habba achar hannefalim kol nefel sheimmo temea leda habba acharav eno peter rechem. vechol nefel sheen immo temea leda kemo hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim o hammappelet yom arbaim vechayyotze bahen habba acharav bechor lakkohen vechayyav lifdot: 
Chatach haubbar bemeeha vehotzio evar evar habba acharav eno peter rechem. ben shemona chodashim shehotzi rosho vehu chay vehecheziro vamet. vechen ben tisha shemmet veyatza rosho vehecheziro veachar kach yatza achiv veyalda. ze sheyyalda eno peter rechem. shehare niftar berosho shel rishon. umishshettetze paddachto poter habba acharav: 
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav kedarko shenehem peturim. harishon lefi shello yatza min harechem vehashsheni mippene shekkedamo acher: 
Meematay yitchayyev befidyon. mishsheyyashlim sheloshim yom shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 16)</small> "ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde". met habben betoch sheloshim vaafillu beyom sheloshim. vechen im naasa terefa. eno chayyav bachamishsha selaim. veim hikdim venatan lakkohen yachzir lo happidyon. [veim met achar sheloshim yom chayyav befidyon] veim lo natan yitten: 
Mi sheppada beno betoch sheloshim yom im amar lo meachshav en beno paduy. veim amar lo leachar sheloshim yom beno paduy veaf al pi sheen hammaot kayyamin leachar sheloshim yom: 
Mi shehu safek im chayyav befidyon o lo hare ze patur shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. met haav betoch sheloshim yom hare habben bechezkat shello nifda ad sheyyavi reaya meaviv sheppadahu kodem sheyyamut. met haav leachar sheloshim yom hare hu bechezkat paduy ad sheyyodiuhu shello nifda: 
Mi shello bikkera ishto veyalda zachar unekeva veen yadua e ze mehen yatza rishon en kan lakkohen kelum. yalda shene zecharim af al pi sheen yadua e ze mehen habbechor noten chamishsha selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom patur shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. met haav ben betoch sheloshim yom ben achar sheloshim yom. ben shello chalku haachim ben shechalku. yinnaten min hannechasim chamishsha selaim lakkohen shekkevar nitchayyevu hannechasim: 
Shete nashav shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim noten asara selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom im lechohen echad natan yachzir lo chamishsha selaim. veim lishne kohanim natan eno yachol lehotzi mehen shehare lo tziyyen pidyon ze al ben ze. vechol echad mehen yachol lomar hachazir mechaveri: 
Shete nashav shello bikkeru sheyyaldu zachar unekeva o shene zecharim unekeva noten chamishsha selaim lakkohen. shei efshar shello yihye zachar echad mehen peter rechem: 
Yaldu shete nekevot vezachar. o shene zecharim ushete nekevot. veen yadua e ze nolad rishon. en kan lakkohen kelum sheani omer nekeva nolda techilla veachareha zachar: 
Shete nashav achat bikkera veachat lo bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim venitarvu. noten chamishsha selaim lakkohen. met echad mehem betoch sheloshim yom haav patur. met haav yinnaten min hannechasim chamishsha selaim: 
Yaldu zachar unekeva o shene zecharim unekeva en kan lakkohen kelum. sheani omer zo shello bikkera yalda nekeva techilla veachareha zachar vezo shebbikkera yalda zachar: 
Shete nashim shel shene anashim shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim venitarvu ze noten chamishsha selaim veze noten chamishsha selaim. natnu veachar kach met echad min habbanim betoch sheloshim yom. im lishne kohanim natnu enan yecholin lehotzi miyyadan. veim lechohen echad natnu kotev echad mehen lachavero hareshaa veyelech ze behareshaa veyachzir min hakkohen chamishsha selaim: 
Yaldu zachar unekeva venitarvu haavot peturin vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo. vechen mevakkeret shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim veyalda veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon shenehen peturin. vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo: 
Yaldu shete nekevot vezachar o shete nekevot ushene zecharim en kan lakkohen kelum: 
Shete nashim shel shene anashim achat bikkera veachat lo bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim. ze shello bikkera ishto noten chamesh selaim lakkohen. yaldu zachar unekeva en kan lakkohen kelum: 
Yaldu shene zecharim unekeva ze shello bikkera ishto noten chamishsha selaim. shello niftar ella bishne sefekot im ishto yalda zachar bilvad chayyav veim hi yalda hazzachar vehannekeva chayyav ella im ken yalda nekeva techilla. vehoil vehaddavar rachok yitten pidyono:

Mitzvat ase lifdot kol dam miyyisrael peter chamor bese. veim lo ratza lifdoto mitzvat ase learfo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "ufeter chamor tifde vese veim lo tifde vaarafto". ushete mitzvot ellu nohagot bechol makom uvechol zeman. umitzvat pediyya kodemet lemitzvat arifa: 
Hasse sheppodin bo notno lakkohen shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "kol peter rechem" vegomer: 
<small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde" behema temea haamura kan hi hachamor bilvad: 
Peter chamor asur bahanaa ad sheyyippade. veim mecharo kodem pidyon damav asurim. veim met kodem pidyon o shearafo yikkaver. mippene shehu asur bahanaa af leachar arifa hoil velo nifda. lefichach im lo padahu venatan peter hachamor beatzmo lakkohen. asur lakkohen lehishtammesh bo ad sheyyifdehu bese. veyikkach hasse leatzmo o yaarfennu veyikkaver. vehakkohanim chashudim al davar ze lefichach asur leyisrael litten peter chamor lakkohen ella im ken padahu hakkohen befanav: 
Hifrish pidyon peter chamor umet hasse kodem sheyyittenennu lakkohen eno chayyav beacharayuto. veyitten hannevela lakkohen lehanot bah. met peter hachamor achar sheppadahu. yitten hattale lakkohen umuttar behanayato shekkevar nifda: 
Meematay chayyav lifdoto mishsheyyivvaled vead sheloshim yom. umeachar sheloshim yom im ratza learfo orfo. im ratza lifdoto pode veen kan ella mitzvat ikkuv bilvad: 
Lo ratza lifdoto orfo bekofitz meachorav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 13)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "veim lo tifde vaarafto". veen memitin oto lo bemakkel velo bekane velo bekordom velo bimgera ella bekofitz. velo yachnisennu lecheder veyinol haddelet befanav ad sheyyamut shenneemar vaarafto: 
En podin lo beegel velo bechayya velo bese shachut velo bitrefa velo bechilayim velo bichvi. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 13)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "tifde bese" veen karuy se ella kevasim veizzim chayyim bilvad: 
En podin bese haddome [lemin] leacher. veim pada paduy. ufodin beven pekua. aval lo bifsule hammukdashin shehare neemar bahen <small>(Devarim 12 15)</small> <small>(Devarim 15 22)</small> "katztzevi vechaayyal". ma tzevi veayyal en podin bo af pesule hammukdashin en podin bahem: 
Podin bese ben zecharim ben nekevot ben temimim ben baale mumim ben ketannim ben gedolim: 
Se shellekacho middeme sheviit en podin bo et havvadday. aval podin bo et hassafek. im en lo se lifdoto podehu beshavyo venoten damav lakkohen. lo amra tora se lehachemir alav ella lehakel alav. sheim haya lo peter chamor sheshshave eser selaim yesh lo lifdoto bese sheve dinar. velo yihye ze chamur min hahekdesh shennifde bechesef beshavyo: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu deme peter chamor mishshelosha zuzim ulemala. aval im hayu damav pachot mishlosha zuzim en podin oto ella bese o bishlosha zuzim. veayin yafa lo yifchot missela. veayin raa bachatzi sela. uvenonit bishlosha zuzim: 
Vhappode peter chamor shel chavero hare ze paduy. vehachamor livalav: 
Kohanim uleviyyim peturin mippeter chamor shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde". kol sheyyeshno bivchor adam yeshno bivchor behema temea. vehappatur mibbechor adam patur mibbechor behema temea: 
Hallokeach ubbar chamoro shel akkum o hammocher ubbar chamoro leakkum af al pi sheeno rashshay hare ze patur min habbechora. veen konsin oto al davar ze. haya haakkum shuttaf baem o babbechor afillu lo haya lo ella echad meelef bo hare ze patur. haya lo bo o beimmo evar echad kegon yado o raglo afillu azno kol sheillu yechatech yihye baal mum hare ze patur min habbechora. veim kesheyyechatech chelek haakkum lo yihye baal mum lammizbeach hare ze chayyav. vechen hamekabbel chamor min haakkum lihyot metappel bah vehavvalad benehem o akkum shekkibbel miyyisrael hakkol patur min habbechora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "peter rechem bivne yisrael baadam uvabbehema" ad sheyyihye hakkol beyisrael: 
Ger shennitgayyer veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyer yalda chamoro o achar shennitgayyer hare ze chayyav laarof o lifdot. veim pada bese hasse shel ger shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Akkum shehifrish peter chamor modiin oto sheeno chayyav vahare hu muttar begizza vaavoda: 
Para sheyyalda kemin chamor o chamor sheyyalda kemin sus patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 20)</small> "ufeter chamor tifde vese" ufeter chamor shete peamim ad sheyyihye hayyoled chamor vehannolad chamor. veim yesh bo miktzat simane chamor chayyav bivchora: 
Chamoro shello bikkera veyalda shene zecharim noten tale lakkohen. yalda zachar unekeva mafrish tale echad kede lehafekia kedushsha mimmennu ad sheyyihye muttar bahanaya. shemma hazzachar nolad techilla. vetale ze shehifrish labbealim veeno lakkohen shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Shete chamorav shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim noten shene telaim lakkohen. zachar unekeva o shene zecharim unekeva noten tale echad lakkohen: 
Yaldu shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot en kan lakkohen kelum. veeno tzarich lehaferish tale leatzmo lefi sheyyesh kan sefekot harebe shemma haachat yalda zachar vehashsheniyya yalda shete nekevot. o shemma zo yalda nekeva vehaacheret zachar veacharav nekeva o nekeva veachareha zachar. vechen sefekot harebe yesh bishne zecharim ushete nekevot. achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim venitarvu noten tale echad lakkohen. zachar unekeva mafrish tale echad leatzmo veeno notno lakkohen mippene shehu safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Vechen hallokeach chamor min haakkum veen yadua im bikkera o lo bikkera veyalda zachar pode oto bese vehu labbealim. mippene shehu safek: 
Mi shehayu lo asara telaim kol echad mehen hifrisho al sefek peter chamor hare hen kechullin lechol davar umitasserin kishar habbehema. umafresh echad mehen maaser vehashshear shello keshehayu: 
Yisrael shehayu lo asara pitre chamorim vaddain betoch beto shennaflu lo mibbet avi immo kohen veoto avi immo hakkohen naflo lo mibbet avi immo yisrael hare ze mafrish alehen asara seyin vehen shello vechayyavin bemaaser: seliku lehu hilchot bikkurim besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 1: Mitzvat ase lehaferish kol peter rechem hazzecharim ben baadam ben bivhema tehora ben mimmin hachamor. ben shehayu shelemim ben shehayu terefot. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "kaddesh li chol bechor peter kol rechem bivne yisrael baadam uvabbehema". vechullan lakkohanim:

Bechor adam uvechor chamor nifdim ufidyonam lakkohanim. uvechor behema tehora nishchat baazara kishar kadashim kallim. zorkin damo umaktir emurav kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot ushear habbasar neechol lakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 15)</small> "ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde" <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "ach bechor shor" <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "lo tifde kodesh hem" <small>(Bamidbar 18 18)</small> "uvesaram yihye lach":

Bechor behema tehora shehu baal mum ben shennolad bemumo ben shennafal bo mum achar shehaya tamim hare hu lakkohen im ratza ochlo bechol makom o mochro o maachilo lemi sheyyirtze afillu lenachri mippene shehu chullin. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 21)</small> "vechi yihye vo mum pisseach o ivver" vegomer <small>(Devarim 15 22)</small> "hattame vehattahor yachdav yochalennu katztzevi vechaayyal" vahare hu nichse kohen:

Mitzva lehakedish bechor behema tehora veyomar hare ze kodesh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "takdish laAdonai elohecha" veim lo hikdisho hare ze mitkaddesh meelav ukedushshato merechem hi:

Mitzvat bechor behema tehora noheget baaretz uvechutza laaretz veen meviin bechorot michutza laaretz laaretz shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha" <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha". mimmakom sheatta mevi maasar dagan atta mevi bechor bakar vatzon umimmakom sheen atta mevi maasar dagan i atta mevi bechor bakar vatzon ella hare hu kechullin veyeachel bemumo. veim hevi en mekabbelin mimmennu velo yikkarev ella yeachel bemumo:
Mitzva zo noheget ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit kemo maasar dagan. veenah noheget bemukdashin keshehen bikdushshatan kodem sheyyippadu ben kadshe mizbeach ben kadshe bedek habbayit:

Hakkol chayyavin bivchor behema tehora kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim. veaf al pi shehabbechor lakkohen im nolad lo bechor makriv damo veemurav kemo shebbearnu veochel shear habbasar betorat bechor. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 19)</small> "kol habbechor asher yivvaled bivkarcha uvetzoncha" vegomer. aval bechor adam uvechor behema temea kohanim uleviyyim peturin kemo shebbearnu behilchot mattenot kehunna:

Habbechor neechol betoch shenato ben tamim ben baal mum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 15 20)</small> "lifne Adonai elohecha tochalennu shana beshana" <small>(Devarim 15 21)</small> "vechi yihye bo mum" <small>(Devarim 15 22)</small> "bisharecha tochalennu". umeematay mone lo. im tam hu mone lo miyyom shemini shehu rauy lehakerava veim nolad baal mum mone lo miyyom shennolad. vehu shekkalu lo chodashav shehare nire laachila beyom ledato. aval im lo yada bevadday shekkalu lo chodashav mone lo miyyom shemini:

Nolad lo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayyemo kol shenem asar chodesh. nolad lo mum besof shenato muttar lekayyemo sheloshim yom miyyom shennafal bo hammum veaf al pi shehu mitacher leachar shenato. ketzad. kegon shennafal bo mum bachamishsha asar yom lifne gemar shenato mashlimin lo chamishsha asar achar shenato. nolad lo mum achar shenato eno rashshay lekayyemo ella ad sheloshim yom veyeachel:
Habbechor bazzeman hazze mannicho ad sheyyippol bo mum veyeachel:

Vead shello nire lehareoto lechacham rashshay lekayyemo shetayim veshalosh shanim. umishshennire lehareoto lechacham. im nolad bo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayyemo kol shenem asar chodesh. nolad achar shenato mekayyemo sheloshim yom:

Shana shel bechor hi shenat levana temima shenem asar chodesh miyyom leyom. veim hayta shana meubberet nitabbera lo umone lo shelosha asar chodesh. noldu lo shene telaim echad bachamishsha asar shel adar harishon veechad berosh chodesh adar sheni. ze shennolad berosh chodesh adar sheni kevan shehiggia yom rishon baadar shel shana habbaa alta lo shana veze shennolad bachatzi adar rishon lo alta lo shana ad chatzi adar shel shana habbaa hoil venolad bechodesh haibbur monin oto lo:

Avar veicher habbechor leachar shenato af al pi shehu over belo taase im haya tam hare ze lo nifsal ella makrivo veim haya baal mum shochato bechol makom shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha" makkish bechor lemaaser ma maaser eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah af bechor eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah:

En notnin et habbechor lakkohen kesheyyivvaled sheen zo gedulla lakkohen. ella yetappel bo bealav ad sheyyagdil meat veyittenennu lakkohen. vead kamma yisrael chayyavin lehittafel babbechor. behema dakka sheloshim yom uvegassa chamishshim yom. veim amar lo hakkohen tenehu li betoch zeman ze vaani atappel leatzmi eno rashshay litteno lo shezze kemo mesayyea al mattenotav uchevar bearnu bitrumot shehakkohanim hamesayyein bevet haggoranot uvevet hammitbachayim uvetoch haroim en notnin lahem mattenotehen bischaran:

Haya habbechor baal mum veamar lo betoch zeman ze tenehu li sheochalennu atta. o shehaya tamim veamar lo tenehu li betoch zeman ze sheakrivennu atta hare ze notno lo. veyerae li shehabbechor noten lechol kohen sheyyirtze:

Kohen sheachal kezayit mibbechor tamim chutz lirushalayim loke min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha". vechen zar sheachal kezayit mibbechor ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika loke. mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara af lezar sheachal bechor ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika:

Habbechor en podin oto shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "ach bechor shor o vechor kesev o vechor ez lo tifde". vechen en mochrin oto keshehu tam shekkevan shehu omed lekarban en lakkohen bo zechut kede lemachro. uvazzeman hazze sheen bayit hoil vehu omed laachila hare hu muttar lemachro veaf al pi shehu tamim ben lechohen ben leyisrael:

Bechor baal mum yesh lakkohen lemachro bechol zeman ben lifne habbayit ben shello lifne habbayit. ben chay ben shachut. ucheshehu mocher besar bechor baal mum mochro babbayit aval lo bashshuk kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach aval besar bechor tamim eno nimkar mippene shehu besar kodesh. vechohanim shennimnu im habbechor muttarin lishkol mana keneged mana:
Hammafshit bechor baal mum hare ze muttar lehafeshito bee ze derech sheyyirtze. im ratza leharegil margil. vechen shear pesule hammukdashin im ratza lehafeshit min haregel mafshit:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 2: Kol hammumim hakkevuim happoslin et hakodashim venifdim alehen. im nafal echad mehen bivchor hare ze nishchat alav bechol makom. uchevar bearnu otan hammumin behilchot issure mizbeach sheharauy mehen lihyot bezachar shishshim veshiva:

Vechol haddevarim shemmaninu sham sheen hakkarban min hammuvchar veen hakkadashim kerevin bahen velo nifdin alehen kach en habbechor nishchat alehen velo karev ella yihye omed ad sheyyivvaled lo mum kavua. vechen im nolad bivchor mum over hare ze eno nishchat bechol makom velo karev ella yihye roe ad sheyyippol bo mum kavua veyishshachet alav:
Vechen im neevda bo avera. o sheharag beed echad. o al pi habbealim. o shehuktza o neevad. yire ad sheyyippol bo mum kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach:
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav shenehen enan bechor. harishon mippene sheeno peter rechem vehaacharon mippene shekkedamo acher. afillu yatza nekeva derech dofen vezachar derech rechem eno bechor:

Bechor shehu anderoginus en bo kedushsha kelal. vahare hu kinkeva sheen bo lakkohen kelum. veovdim bo vegozzim oto kishar hachullin. nolad tumtum hare ze sefek bechor veyeachel bemumo livalav. ben shehetil mayim mimmekom zichrut ben shehetil mimmekom nakvut:

Rachel sheyyalda kemin ez. o ez sheyyalda kemin rachel patur min habbechora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "ach bechor shor" ad sheyyihye hu shor uvechoro shor. veim haya bo miktzat simane immo hare ze bechor vehu baal mum kavua sheen lecha mum gadol mishshinnuy beriyyato. afillu para sheyyalda kemin chamor veyesh bo miktzat simane para hare ze bechor lakkohen hoil umin hachamor yesh bo din bechor. aval im yalda min sus o gamal af al pi sheyyesh bo miktzat simane para hare hu sefek bechor lefichach yeachel labbealim. veim tefaso kohen en motziin miyyado:
Hammattil mum bivchor hoil veasa avera konsin oto veeno nishchat al mum ze ad sheyyippol bo mum acher meelav. veim met ze hachote muttar livno leshochoto al mum sheasa aviv shello kansu beno acharav:

Hirgil labbechor sheyyippol bo mum kegon shennatan devela al azno ad shebba kelev unetalah vechatach azno. o shehalach ben barzel vaashashiyyot shel zechuchit kede shettikkata yado veniktea. o sheamar lenachri lehattil bo mum. hare ze lo yishchot alav. ze hakkelal kol mum shennaasa ledato asur lo lishchot alav veim naasa shello ledato hare ze shochet alav:
Amar illu nafal bivchor ze mum hayiti shochato veshama hannachri veasa bo mum hare ze shochet alav shehare lo naasa bedato:

Reinuhu sheasa maase hammargil lehattil bo mum venafal bo mum veen anu yodin im nitkavven lemum ze o lo nitkavven. hare ze lo yishchot alav. ketzad. kegon shennatan lo seorim bemakom dachuk mesorag bekotzim vechevan sheachal nechlak sefato afillu haya chaver hare ze lo yishchot alav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Haya bechor rodef et haadam uvaato kede letardo vaafillu baat bo mippene sherdafo mikkodem venaasa bo mum bivita zo hare ze yishchat alav:
Ketannim shehittilu mum bivchor derech sechok vechen hannachri sheasa ledato hare ze yishchot alav. veim asu kede lehattiro lo yishchot alav:
Bechor sheachazo dam yakkiz. uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot bo mum. veim naasa bo mum behakkaza zo hare ze nishchat alav:

Muttar lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyetze laavir haolam veyishchat alav. bamme devarim amurim bazzeman hazze sheen sham bayit mippene shessofo leheachel bemumo. aval bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam asur:
Ed sheheid mippi ed achar shemmum ze nafal shello ledaat neeman. afillu ishsha neemenet lomar befanay nafal mum ze meelav veyishchat alav:

Kol hammumin haruyin lavo bide adam neeman haroe alehen lomar mealehen naflu velo naasu bechavvana veyishchat alehen. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya haroe yisrael vehabbechor beyad hakkohen. aval im haya haroe kohen vehabbechor adayin hu beyad bealav hayyisreeli. hare ze eno neeman vechoshdin oto shemma hu hittil bo mum kede sheyyittenennu lo:

Kohen sheheid lechohen acher shemmum ze meelav nafal neeman veen choshshin lahen shemma hem gomlim ze et ze. shekkol hakkohanim chashudin lehattil mum bivchor kede leachlo bachutz ulefichach en neemanin al yede atzman. aval chavero meid lo, sheen adam chote leacher. afillu banav uvene beto shel kohen meidin lo al habbechor aval lo ishto mippene shehi kegufo:

Bechor shehaya beyad kohen venafal bo mum veheid alav ed echad shezze hammum meelav nafal veen anu yodim im mum ze shochatin alav et habbechor o en shochatin alav uva hakkohen shehu beyado veamar hereti mum ze lemumche vehittiro lishchita hare ze neeman. veen choshshin shemma lo herahu veshemma bechor tam hu shello nechshedu lishchot kadashim bachutz mippene shehu avon karet kemo shebbearnu:

Vechen neeman hakkohen lomar al bechor baal mum bechor ze netano li yisrael bemumo velo nafal birshuti kede lachush lo shemma hu hittilo. shehaddavar asuy lehiggalot vehu mityare shemma yishalu bealav veyomar tamim haya beet shennetanuhu lo:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 3:
En shochatin et habbechor ella al pi mumche shennatan lo hannasi shebbeeretz yisrael reshut veamar lo hatter bechorot bemuman. afillu haya mum gadol vegaluy lakkol lo yattiro ella mumche shennatal reshut. vechol habbechorot adam roe chutz mibbechore atzmo:
Im en sham mumche vehaya hammum min hammumin haggeluyin hammuvhakin. kegon shennismet eno. o niktea yado. o nishbera raglo. hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset. vechen bechor sheyyatza lechutza laaretz venafal bo mum muvhak. hare ze yuttar al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset:
En roin et habbechor leyisrael ad sheyyihye kohen immo. shemma yomar lo hammumche mum hu umuttar lishchot alav veyelech veyishchatennu leatzmo velo yittenennu lakkohen. sheaf al pi sheeno chashud leechol kadashim bachutz. chashud hu ligzol mattenot kehunna. lefichach im haya chacham veyadua shehu medakdek al atzmo roin lo. haya hammum galuy lakkol kegon shenniktea yado o raglo. hoil vehevio lechacham hammumche hare ze bechezkat medakdek al atzmo lefichach roin lo af al pi sheen immo kohen:
Hashshochet et habbechor veachar kach hera et mumo af al pi shehu mum galuy sheeno mishtanne bishchita kegon shennechtecha yado o raglo hoil venishchat shello al pi mumche hare ze asur veyikkaver kivchor shemmet:
Bechor shehayta lo betza achat ushene kisim. uvedako hammumche vehoshivuhu al haregozo umiachu velo yatzat betza sheniyya vehittiro hammumche venishchat venimtza hashsheniyya devuka bakkesalim hare ze muttar hoil umiachu. aval im lo nimach af al pi shennishchat al pi mumche hare ze yikkaver:
Mi sheeno mumche veraa et habbechor venishchat al piv. hare ze yikkaver vishallem mibbeto. vechamma meshallem. revia ledakka umechetza legassa. umippene ma lo yeshallem kol damav mippene shekkansu et baal habbehema kede shello yashhenna velo yegaddel behema dakka beeretz yisrael:
Hannotel secharo lihyot roe bechorot en shochatin al piv ella im ken haya mumche gadol veyadu bo chachamim sheen kemoto ufasku lo sachar al hariyya vehabbikkur ben shennimtza bo mum ben shennimtza tamim. velo yittol sachar al behema zo chutz mippaam achat veroe otah leolam kol zeman shemmeviin otah kede shello yavo lide chashad:
Hechashud al habbechorot lemachran leshem chullin en lokchin mimmennu afillu besar tzevaim mippene shehu dome livsar egel. veen lokchim mimmennu orot sheenan avudim afillu shel nekeva shemma yachtoch zichruto veyomar or nekeva hu. veen lokchin mimmennu tzemer afillu melubban veen tzarich lomar tzoi. aval lokchin mimmennu tauuy ulevadin veorot avudim. sheeno meabbed or bechor tamim mippene shehu mefached lashhoto etzlo shemma yishmeu haddayyanim veyiknesuhu kefi risho:
Hashshochet et habbechor umecharo venoda shello herahu lemumche. ma sheachlu achlu veyachzir lahem et haddamim. uma shello neechal yikkaver veyachzir et haddamim. vechen haddin bemaachil et hatterefa kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mikkach umimkar:
Bechor shennimtza terefa im tamim hu venimtza terefa achar shehufshat haor yissaref kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin vehabbasar yikkaver. veim bemumo nishchat habbasar yikkaver veyehanu hakkohanim beoro. vehu shennishchat al pi mumche:
Habbechor shenneechal besaro kahalacha ben tamim ben baal mum. keshem shemmuttar lehanot beoro kach nehenin begizzotav. aval kol tzemer shennigzaz mimmennu keshehu chay afillu nashar hare hu asur bahanaa. vaafillu nashar mimmennu achar shennafal bo mum. vaafillu achar shechitato veen tzarich lomar achar mitato shehare oto hatztzemer shennashar mimmennu mechayyim beissuro omed. vechen bemaasar behema. uchevar bearnu behilchot meila shello gazru gezera zo ella al habbechor veal hammaaser bilvad mippene sheenan bain lechappara shemma yashhem etzlo kede likkach kol hatztzemer sheyyinshor mehem. uchevar bearnu shemmitzva leachlo toch shenato ben tamim ben baal mum:
Bechor shehaya bo tzemer meduvlal ushechato. et shehu nire immo min haggizza muttar bahanaa. veet sheeno nire immo vehu hatztzemer sheikkaro hafuch kelappe rosho asur. shezze kemo shennashar mechayyim:
Gizzat bechor afillu baal mum shennitarva begizze chullin afillu achat bechamma alafim hakkol asurim. hare hu davar chashuv umekaddesh bechol shehu. haoreg melo hassit mitztzemer habbechor beveged yiddalek. mitztzemer hammukdashin mekaddesh bechol shehu:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 4: Vehemat hashshuttafin chayyevet bivchora. lo neemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 23)</small> "bekarcha vetzonecha" ella lemaet shuttafut hannachri sheim haya shuttaf bappara o baubbar afillu haya lannachri echad meelef baem o bavvalad hare ze patur min habbechora. haya lo beechad mishshenehem evar echad kegon yad o regel. roin kol sheillu yechatech vehaya baal mum hare ze patur. veim efshar sheyyechatech evar hannachri velo yippasel. hare ze chayyav bivchora:
Hallokeach ubbar parato shel nachri. o hammocher ubbar parato lenachri. af al pi sheeno rashshay hare ze patur min habbechora. veen konsin oto al davar ze:

Hamekabbel behema min hannachri lihyot metappel bah vehavveladot benehem. o nachri shekkibbel miyyisrael kaze. hare ellu peturim min habbechora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 2)</small> "peter kol rechem bivne yisrael" ad sheyyihye hakkol miyyisrael:

Hamekabbel tzon min hannachri bemamon katzuv ufasak immo sheyyihye hassachar benehem veim pichatu pichatu leyisrael. af al pi shebbirshut yisrael hem vahare hem kekinyano hoil veim lo yimtza hannachri etzlo mamon acher ligbot mimmennu yigbe min habbehemot haellu umivvaldotehen naasa kemo sheyyesh lo acharayut alehen veal valdotehen vahare yad hannachri beemtza ufeturin min habbechora hem uvaldotehen. aval valde veladot chayyavin shehare shel yisrael hem veen lannachri reshut alehen:

Yisrael shennatan maot lenachri vekana lo bahen behema minnachri bedinehen af al pi shello mashach kana vechayyevet bivchora. vechen im kana hannachri miyyisrael bedinehem venatan maot af al pi shello mashach kana ufetura mibbechora:
Ger shennitgayyer veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyer yalda parato o achar shennitgayyer hare ze bechor missafek:
Hallokeach behema min hannachri veen yadua im bikkera o lo bikkera veyalda etzlo hare ze sefek bechor veyeachel bemumo labbealim veeno lakkohen shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya:

Lakach behema menika min hannachri eno choshesh shemma benah shel acheret hi menika ella hare zo bechezkat sheyyalda. vaafillu haya ze shemmenika kemo min acher vaafillu kemin chazir hare zo petura min habbechora. vechen behema shehi cholevet petura min habbechora sherov habbehemot enan cholvot ella im ken kevar yaldu:

Hallokeach behema miyyisrael hare zo bechezkat shebbikkera ad sheyyodio hammocher sheadayin lo yalda. sheen hayyisrael shotek vegorem lo leechol kadashim bachutz vadday shebbikkera ulefichach mecharah setam:

Behema dakka shehippila ubbar sheadayin lo nitbaer tzurato harebe venikkeret lakkol vezehu hannikra tinnuf. im amru haroim ubbar hu ella shennifseda tzurato hare zo petura min habbechora vetzarich lehareoto leroe chacham. lefichach hallokeach behema min hannachri afillu hayta ketanna veyalda etzlo betoch shenatah hare ze sefek bechor shemma tinnuf hippila birshut hannachri. vechen behema gassa shehippila shilya hare zo siman valad sheen shilya belo valad veniftera min habbechora. umuttar lehashelich otah hashshilya lakkelavim sheen mitkaddesh bivchora ella zachar vechezkat hannoladim mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot. uchevar bearnu shehazzachar sheen bo miktzat simane immo eno mitkaddesh bivchora venimtza miut hannoladim hen hammitkaddeshin bivchora veen choshshin lemiut. aval behemat kadashim shehippila shilya tikkaver [shehannekevot bah kizcharim]:

Behema gassa shehippila chararat dam hare zo niftera min habbechora shechezkatah shehavvalad betochah verava alav haddam vehifsido uvittelo. vekovrin charara zo kemo nefel mevakkeret af al pi sheen charara zo kedosha. velamma kovrin otah kede lefarsem haddavar shenniftera min habbechora:

Kevar bearnu beinyan nidda shehavvalad baadam nigmar learbaim yom vehammappelet lefachot mearbaim eno valad. aval velad behema lo amdu chachamim al minyan hayyamim sheyyiggamer bo. aval amru shehammappelet tinnuf enah mitabberet acharav velo mekabbelet valad acher lefachot mishsheloshim yom:
Behema sheyyatza melea uvaa rekanit habba achar ken bechor missafek shemma davar sheeno poter bivchora hippila. veen lenifle behema petirat rechem ad sheyyaagilu rosh kefika shel erev:

Mavkeret hammaksha leled mechattech evar umashlich lakkelavim vehabba acharav bechor. yatza rubbo hare ze yikkaver veniftera min habbechora. veim chatach evar vehinnicho evar vehinnicho ad shehishlim rubbo hare kol haevarim tzerichin kevura. veniftera min habbechora kevan sheyyatza rubbo ben shalem ben mechuttach vahare hu lefanenu nitkaddesh lemafrea:

Yatza shelish umecharo lenachri vechazar veyatza shelish acher. nitkaddesh lemafrea veniftera min habbechora. yatza shelish derech dofen ushene shelishim derech rechem eno kadosh sheharov harishon lo yatza derech rechem ulemafrea hu mitkaddesh:

Yatza miut evar gadol vahare ze hayyotze rubbo shel ubbar niftar min habbechora veyikkaver hayyotze. yatza chatzi haubbar vehu rubbo shel evar hayyotze hare ze safek im niftera min habbechora o lo niftera lefichach habba acharav sefek bechor:
Bechor shekkeracho besiv vehotzio velo naga barechem o shekkeracho beshilyat behema acheret o shennichrecha alav achoto veyatza hoil velo naga barechem mikkol makom hare ze sefek bechor:
Hidbik shene rechamim ze laze veyatza mizze venichnas laze hare ze safek im niftera min habbechora habbehema shennichnas bah habbechor shehare peter rechem o lo niftera ad sheyyiftor rachmah veladah:
Niftechu katle bet harechem veyatza hare ze safek im negiat rechem mekaddeshet o aviro:
Neekru katle bet harechem [venitlu] betzavvaro hare ze safek im bimkomo mekaddesh o mekaddesh af chutz limkomo:
Nigmemu katle bet harechem eno kadosh. nifratz miktzato veomed merubbe al happarutz veyatza derech happarutz. o shehaya happarutz merubbe al haomed veyatza derech haomed hare ze sefek bechor:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 5:
Rachel shello bikkera veyalda shene zecharim. afillu yatzu shene rashehen keechad i efshar shello kadam echad. hoil veen yadua e ze mehem yatza rishon hakkohen notel et hakkachush vehashsheni sefek bechor. met echad mehen en lakkohen kelum shezze hachay safek hu vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vechen im yalda zachar unekeva hare hazzachar safek shemma hannekeva yatzat techilla lefichach en lakkohen kelum shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya:
Shete rechelot shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim. shenehen lakkohen. zachar unekeva hazzachar lakkohen. shene zecharim unekeva hakkohen notel et hakkachush vehashsheni sefek bechor. veim met echad mehen en lakkohen kelum. shezze hazzachar hachay sefek bechor hu vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. yaldu shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot hare hazzecharim sefek bechor. sheani omer shemma hannekeva nolda techilla veachar kach hazzachar. lefichach en kan lakkohen kelum shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera veyaldu lo shene zecharim. echad lo veechad lakkohen vechol echad mehen sefek bechor vehakkohen notel et hakkachush. met echad mehen en kan lakkohen kelum shezze hachay safek hu. vechen im yaldu zachar unekeva en kan lakkohen kelum shezze hazzachar sefek bechor hu:
Kol bechor shehu safek dino sheyyire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyeachel livalav. veim tefaso hakkohen en motziin oto miyyado veochel oto bemumo. aval eno makrivo sheen makriv leolam ella bechor vadday shemma yishchot chullin baazara:
Mi shehaya beedro mevakkerot vesheenan mevakkerot veyaldu veen sham adam venichnas umatza et hamevakkerot menikot nekevot veet sheenan mevakkerot menikot zecharim. eno choshesh shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo uvenah shel zo ba lo etzel zo ella hare haddavar bechezkato shekkol achat menika benah:
Shenayim shehifkidu shene zecharim etzel haroe haechad bechor vehashsheni pashut umet echad mehen. manniach haroe hashsheni benehen umistallek vahare hu sefek bechor ushenehen cholkin oto sheen echad mehen makkir et shello:
Hifkid bechor etzel baal habbayit vehinnicho baal habbayit im pashut shello umet echad mehen veen yadua ezehu. hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vahare hu sefek bechor. vaafillu roe kohen shehinniach bechoro bachatzar baal habbayit im pashut shel baal habbayit umet echad mehen hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. veen motziin mechatzar baal habbayit ella biraya. shehare middaat baal habbechor hinnichu immo happashut shel baal habbayit:
Lo nechshedu yisrael al habbechorot lefichach neeman hayyisrael lomar ze sefek bechor hu veroin lo mumo veochel oto bemumo:
Kol hakkadashim shekkadam lahem mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin bivchora. veim kadam mum over lehekdeshan o shehikdishan temimim veachar kach nolad lahem mum kavua venifdu peturin min habbechora. shehare lo yatzu lechullin lechol davar mippene shehen asurin begizza vaavoda kemo shebbearnu behilchot meila:
Hallokeach behema mimmeot maaser sheni birushalayim chayyevet bivchora. aval hallokeach behema mipperot sheviit hare zo petura min habbechora lefi sheeno rashshay laasot sechora beferot sheviit shehare neemar bah <small>(Vayikra 25 6)</small> "leachlah" leachlah velo lischora. veim tihye chayyevet bivchora hare ze mistakker bivchor shehare yatza mittorat perot sheviit. uchevar bearnu behilchot maachalot asurot sheasur laasot sechora bidvarim haasurim baachila vechen bearnu bitrumot sheasur laasot sechora bitrumot vechen asur laasot sechora bivchorot af al pi shemmuttar lemachran al derech shebbearnu: 
Lakach bechor lemishte beno o laregel velo tzarich lo muttar lemachro:
En shamin bechorot temimim leyisrael aval shamin lahen bechorot baale mumin. veshamin bechorot temimim lakkohanim bazzeman hazze shehen omdin leheachel bemuman. veen tzarich lomar sheshshamin lahen baale mumim:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 6: Mitzvat ase lehaferish echad measara mikkol behemot tehorot sheyyivvaldu laadam bechol shana veshana. veen mitzva zo noheget ella bevakar vetzon bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 32)</small> "vechol masar bakar vatzon" vegomer:

Maasar behema noheg bechullin aval lo bemukdashin. venoheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit. aval chachamim asru leasser behema bazzeman hazze vetikkenu sheen measserin ella bifne habbayit gezera shemma yochlehu tamim venimtza ba lide issur karet shehu shechitat kadashim bachutz. veim avar veasa bazzeman hazze hare ze maaser veyeachel bemumo:
Hakkol chayyavin bemaasar behema. kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim:

Vedin maasar behema sheyyihye nishchat baazara vezorkin et damo zerika achat keneged hayesod umaktirin emurav. ushear habbasar neechol labbealim birushalayim kishar kadashim kallim veen lakkohanim bo kelum ella kullo labbealim kappesach. veim haya baal mum ben shennafal bo mum ben shehifrisho battechilla bemumo hare ze neechol bechol makom:

Maasar behema asur lemachro keshehu tamim shenneemar bo <small>(Vayikra 27 33)</small> "lo yiggael". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar lo yiggael af issur mechira bemashma sheen nigal veeno nimkar kelal. veyerae li shehammocher maaser lo asa kelum velo kana lokeach. ulefichach eno loke kemocher cherme kohanim shello kana lokeach uchemocher yefat toar kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:
Middivre sofrim sheasur lemachro baal mum vaafillu shachut gezera shemma yimkerennu chay. lefichach en shoklin mana keneged mana bemaaser kederech sheshshoklin bivchor. mippene shehu nire kemocher:
Umaasar behema shel yetomim shennishchat bemumo muttar lemachro kedarko. mippene hashavat aveda litomim lo gazru alav:

Maasar behema shennishchat bemumo muttar limkor chelbo vegidav veoro veatzmotav. velo asru limkor ella besaro bilvad. veim hivlia deme habbasar bidme haor vehachelev vehaggidin umachar hakkol behavelaa muttar. veim hayu deme haatzamot yekarim vehivlia deme habbasar bidme haatzamot muttar:

Hakkol neemanim al mume maaser lomar mum ze meelav ba velo naasa ledaat. vaafillu ellu sheenan neemanim al habbechor neemanim al hammaaser. veroe adam mume maaser shello umattiro im haya mumche. sheim yirtze yattil mum bechol edro veachar kach yeasser venimtza hammaaser baal mum mittechillato:

Hallokeach telaim shennoldu beshana zo o shennittenu lo bemattana hare hem peturim min hammaaser ad sheyyivvaldu birshuto. lefichach hashshuttafin shennishtattefu bivhemot vehevi ze mea telaim veze mea telaim veervum venishtattefu bahen hare hammatayim peturim min hammaaser shekkol tale mehen kemachur. vechen haachim sheyyarshu telaim meavihem hare hen peturin min hammaaser. aval hannoladim lahem beshuttafut leachar mikkan meellu habbehemot ben lashshuttafin ben laachim chayyavin bemaaser. vechen im hayu shuttafin bemaot vekanu behemot mimmeot hashshuttafut vehaachim shekkanu behemot mimmeot hayerushsha hare hannoladim mehem leachar mikkan chayyavin bemaaser shehare birshutan noldu vahare hen keish echad. chalku haachim vehashshuttafin achar shennoldu lahen habbehemot birshutan vechazru venishtattefu hare ellu peturin min hammaaser. shebbeshaa shechalku naasu hakkol lekuchin vehallakuach patur ucheshechazru venishtattefu hare nishtattefu babbehemot vaadayin lo yaldu lahen birshutan achar shittuf ze hashsheni. veaf al pi shechalku gedayim keneged gedayim utelaim keneged telaim vaasara keneged asara hakkol peturin min hammaaser vahare hen kilkuchin:

Haachin vehashshuttafin shechalku bichsafim velo chalku bivhema chayyavin bemaaser sheadayin lo naasu habbehemot lekuchin. aval im chalku habbehemot af al pi sheadayin lo chalku hakkesafim hare ellu peturin:
Hallokeach asara ubbarim bime imman. kullan nichnasin laddir lehitasser shehare birshuto noldu:
Kohen shennaflu lo eser behemot begezel hagger peturim min hammaaser. shemmattenot kehunna mattanot hem. uchevar bearnu shehannoten mattana patur min hammaaser:

Hakkol nichnasin laddir lehitasser. ben temimim ben baale mumin. vechol issure mizbeach. chutz min hakkilayim. vehatterefa. veyotze dofen. umechussar zeman. shekkol ellu peturin min hammaaser. vechen hayyatom shemmeta immo o nishchata im ledato eno mitasser. udevarim ellu mippi hashshemua hem:

En hallokeach patur ella im ken nilkach achar shennira lehitasser. lefichach hallokeach telaim betoch shivat yeme halleda kesheyyaggia zemannam chayyav leasseran. shekkevan sheen mechussar zeman rauy lehitasser hare ze kemi shellakach ubbarim venoldu birshuto:

Kol behema shehi safek im bat maaser hi o enah bat maaser. hare hi petura min hammaaser. lefichach telaim shennitarev bahen yatom o lakuach vechayyotze bahen hare kullan peturin min hammaaser. shekkol echad mehen safek hu:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 7:
Mi shehayu lo asara telaim vehifrish echad measara. hayu lo mea vehifrish asara lemaaser. en ellu maaser. ella ketzad ose. kones kol hattelaim o kol haagalim laddir. veose lo petach katan kede shello yetzu shenayim keechad. veimmotehen maamid mibbachutz. vehen goot sheyyishmeu hattelaim kolan veyetzu min haddir likratan. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 32)</small> "kl asher yaavor tachat hashshavet". sheyyaavor meatzmo velo sheyyotzio beyado. uchesheyyetzu min haddir ze achar ze. matchil umone otan bashshevet. 1 2 3 4 Adonai 6 7 8 9. vehayyotze asiri ben zachar ben nekeva ben tamim ben baal mum sokro besikra veomer hare ze maaser. lo sekaro besikra velo menaan bashshevet o shemmenaan revutzim o omdim hare ellu maaser hoil umenaam asara asara vekiddesh asiri hare ze maaser:
En tzarich letzaref kol behema shennolda birshuto ledir echad ella metzaref kol eder veeder levaddo. hayu lo chamishsha telaim birushalayim vachamishsha telaim beakko en mitztarfin vechullan peturin min hammaaser. vechamma yihye ben ellu leellu veyitztarfu shishsha asar mil:
Hayu shelosha adarim ben kol echad veechad shishsha asar mil hare shelashtan mitztarfin. ketzad. haya tisha mikkan vetisha mikkan veechad beemtza hare shelashtan nichnasin laddir lehitasser:
En measserin min hatztzon al habbakar velo min habbakar al hatztzon. aval measserin min hakkevasim al haizzim umin haizzim al hakkevasim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 32)</small> "vechol masar bakar vatzon" mashma kol tzon echad sheshshenehem nikraim se vahare hem kemin echad:
En measserim min hannoladim beshana zo al hannoladim beshana acheret keshem sheen measserin bezera haaretz min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 22)</small> "hayyotze hassade shana shana". veyerae li sheim isser behema mishshana al shana hare ze maaser mippene chumrat hakodashim shehare lo hikpida tora al maasar behema beferush sheyyihye shana shana:
Kol hannoladim beechad betishre ad esrim vetisha beelul mitztarfin umeasserin meellu al ellu. noldu chamishsha telaim beesrim vetisha beelul vachamishsha beechad betishre en mitztarfin. yaldu toladot betoch shenatan hare hi uvittah nichnasim laddir lehitasser:
En hattelaim hannoladim kemo hattevel sheasur leechol mimmennu ad sheyyeasser kemo shebbearnu bimkomo ella muttar limkor velishchot kol ma sheyyirtze ad sheyyeasser veyihye hammaaser kodesh veyeachel kehilchato kemo shebbearnu:
Kavu chachamim shelosha zemannim beshana lemaasar behema umishsheyaggia zeman mehen asur lo limkor o lishchot ad sheyyeasser veim shachat hare ze muttar. veellu hen hashshelosha zemannim. beyom chamishsha asar kodem happesach uvayyom chamishsha asar kodem atzeret uvayyom chamishsha asar kodem hechag. vechol zeman meellu nikra goren maasar behema. nimtzeta omer shehaggoranot shel maasar behema beyom acharon mechodesh adar uvayyom sheloshim vachamishsha missefirat haomer uveyom acharon mechodesh elul. velamma kavu haggoranot bayamim ellu kede shettihyena habbehemot metzuyot leole regalim. sheaf al pi shemmuttar limkor kodem sheyyeasser kemo shebbearnu hayu nimnaim limkor ad sheyyeasseru veyaasu hammitzva:
Hichnis kol hatztzon o habbakar laddir vehitchil limnot ulekaddesh asiri ad shennisharu betoch haddir pachot measara hare ze mannichan legoren acher vehen mitztarfin leellu sheyyivvaldu veyitasseru hakkol begoren echad. veaf al pi shehu yodea sheellu yishshaaru bamminyan chayyav lehachenis hakkol laddir vehannishar yishshaer:
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 8:
Hammachnnis tzon laddir vehitchilu latzet achat achat vehu mone kemo shebbearnu vetaa bamminyan vekara lashshemini o leshellematta mimmennu asiri o shekkara lashshenem asar o shellemala mimmennu asiri lo nitkaddeshu. aval im kara latteshii o laachad asar asiri nitkaddeshu. vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala nishma shehattaut mitkaddeshot lemaaser shellemala mimmennu veshellematta mimmennu aval lo shellifnehem veshelleacharehem. afillu kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri ben betaut ben bechavvana shelashtan mukdashim:
Veheach dinam. hatteshii eno karev ella neechol bemumo. vehaasiri maaser. vehaachad asar yikkarev shelamim vetaun nesachim kishlamim veeno ose temura mippene shehu atzmo kitmura. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hammone hu baal habbehemot aval haose shaliach leasser lo vetaa ben batteshii ben baachad asar en mekaddesh ella haasiri havvadday bilvad. shello asaahu shaliach litot ulehafsid ella lekaddesh karauy:
Ze sheamarnu sheim kara laachad asar asiri nitkaddesh keshekkara laasiri teshii aval im kara laasiri asiri vekara acharav laachad asar asiri lo nitkaddesh achad asar shehare haasiri havvadday lo akar shem asiri mealav. vaafillu yatza haasiri velo keraahu lo asiri velo achad asar ella shatak veachar kach yatza achad asar ukeraahu asiri lo nitkaddesh shehaasiri meatzmo nitkaddesh. veaf al pi shello keraahu asiri hoil velo akar shem asiri mealav en achad asar mekuddash:
Yatzu teshii vaasiri keechad ben shekkara shenehem asiri. ben shekkeraam teshii. shenehem mukdashin veyeachlu bemuman veenan kerevin. vechen im yatza asiri veachad asar keechad. im keraan asiri hare asiri veachad asar meoravim ze baze vehem kemo maaser shennitarev bishlamim sheyyeachlu bemuman kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin. veim keraan achad asar hare haasiri vehachullin meoravin ze baze veyeachlu bemuman:
Hitchil limnot veyatzu techilla shenayim shehen rishon vesheni hare ze mone hakkol zug zug umekaddesh zug asiri. vechen im menaan shelosha shelosha bechol paam ufaam o chamishsha chamishsha mekaddesh hakkat haasirit:
Yatzu battechilla shenayim umenaan echad vekara hashshelishi sheyyatza acharehen sheni umana kedarko echad echad hare hatteshii vehaasiri mukdashin veyeachlu bemuman. hatteshii mippene shehu haasiri havvadday shehare shenayim yatzu battechilla. veze shekkerao asiri hu achad asar vehakkore leachad asar asiri nitkaddesh kemo shebbearnu:
Menaan lemafrea kegon sheyyatza rishon veamar asiri veyatza sheni veamar teshii ad sheyyatza haasiri umana achat hare ze kadash shehaasiri meelav nitkaddesh:
