Kara latteshii asiri venishar haasiri baddir. hatteshii yeachel bemumo veze shennishar baddir maaser af al pi shello yatza velo berro shehaasiri meelav nitkaddesh. met haasiri baddir hatteshii yeachel bemumo vechol hashshemona sheyyatzu venimnu peturin veaf al pi shello nitkaddesh asiri shellahen likkarev ella met kodem sheyyatza. shehamminyan harauy poter:
Hichnis asara telaim laddir vehaya mone veholech. met echad min hammenuyin mone umashlim kedarko umekaddesh asiri af al pi sheen sham atta chayyim ella tisha:
Met echad meellu shebbetoch haddir ellu shennimnu peturin mippene shehamminyan harauy lemaaser poter af al pi shello hifrish alehen kemo shebbearnu. veellu shebbetoch haddir mannichan legoren acher ad sheyyitztarfu laacherim. vechen mi shehayu lo arbaa asar telaim vehichnisan laddir veyatzu arbaa umenaan befetach ze veyatzu shishsha umenaan befetach acher venisharu sham arbaa betoch haddir. im yatzu haarbaa hannisharim min happetach sheyyatzu bo hashshishsha notel mehen echad vechullan peturin. sheotan haarbaa sheyyatzu techilla mippetach rishon minyan harauy petaran. veim yatzu ellu haarbaa hannisharim min happetach sheyyatzu bo haarbaa techilla. hare otam haarbaa sheyyatzu battechilla veotan hashshishsha sheyyatzu acharehen befetach sheni peturin shekkol echad mehen nimne minyan harauy lemaaser shehare nisharu sham baddir acherim lehashelim hamminyan uleasser. aval ellu haarbaa shennisharu af al pi sheyyatzu venimnu mippetach harishon eno minyan harauy lefichach mitztarfin legoren acher. yatzu arbaa mippetach ze vearbaa mippetach sheni venisharu sham shishsha. im yatzu hashshishsha meechad mishshene happetachim notel mehen echad maaser vechullan peturin. veim yatzu hashshishsha bishne happetachim hare hashshishsha mitztarfin legoren acher vehashshemona sheyyatzu techilla mikkan umikkan peturin shekkol arbaa mehen nimnu minyan harauy lehashelim alav asara uleasser shehare shishsha hayu sham nisharim betoch haddir:
Hayu lo tisha asar telaim betoch haddir veyatzu tisha befetach ze vetisha befetach sheni notel haacharon leshem maaser vechullan peturin. sheotan hattisha nimnu minyan harauy:
Haya mone vehotzi hattale rosho verubbo min haddir vechazar hare hu kemanuy lechol davar:
Haya mone vehifsik hamminyan mippene chavero sheddibber immo o shechashcha lel shabbat hare ze chozer umashlim minyano achar kach:
Haya mone hayyotzin echad echad umekaddesh asiri vekafatz echad min hammenuyin letoch haddir letoch ellu sheadayin lo nimnu velo nitasseru. nifteru hakkol. shekkol echad mehen safek im hu hammanuy shekkafatz o acher. uchevar bearnu shekkol hammenuyin peturin:
Kafatz echad min haasiriyyim letoch haddir. kullan yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyeachlu bemuman:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 1:
Mitzvat ase leda hassimanin shemmavdilin bahen ben behema vechayya veof vedagim vachagavim shemmuttar leachlan uven sheen muttar leachlan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 25)</small> "vehivdaltem ben habbehema hattehora lattemea uven haof hattame lattahor". veneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 47)</small> "lehavedil ben hattame uven hattahor uven hachayya hanneechelet uven hachayya asher lo teachel": 
Simane behema vechayya nitparshu battora vehem shene simanin <small>(Vayikra 11 3)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 6)</small> "mafreset parsa" u <small>(Vayikra 11 3)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 6)</small> "maalat gera" ad sheyyihyu shenehem. vechol behema vechayya shehi maalat gera en lah shinnayim ballechi haelyon. vechol behema shehi maalat gera hare hi mafreset parsa. chutz min haggamal. vechol behema shehi mafreset parsa hi maalat gera chutz min hachazir: 
Lefichach hammotze behema bammidbar veeno makkirah umetzaah chatuchat happerasot bodek befiha im en lah shinnayim lemala beyadua shehi tehora. vehu sheyyakkir gamal. matza behema sheppiha chatuch bodek befarsoteha im hi shesua tehora. vehu sheyyakkir chazir. matza piha chatuch veragleha chatuchot bodek bah achar sheshshechatah bechanfe haoketz im matza besarah sham mahalach sheti vaerev tehora. vehu sheyyakkir arod shekken hu besaro sheti vaerev: 
Behema tehora sheyyalda kemin behema temea af al pi sheeno mafris parsa velo maale gera ella kemin sus o chamor lechol davar hare ze muttar baachila. bamme devarim amurim besheyyalda lefanav. aval im hinniach para meubberet beedro uva umatza kemin chazir karuch achareha af al pi shehu yonek mimmenna hare ze safek veasur baachila. shemma min hattuma nolad venichrach achar hattehora: 
Behema temea sheyyalda kemin behema tehora af al pi shehu mafris parsa umaale gera vahare hu kemin shor lechol davar o kemin se hare ze asur baachila. shehaggadel min hattemea tame umin hattehora tahor. (lefichach) dag tame shennimtza bime dag tahor asur. vedag tahor hannimtza bime dag tame muttar lefi sheen giddulav ella belao: 
Behema tehora sheyyalda o shennimtza bah beriyya sheyyesh lah shete gabbin ushete shedarot asura baachila. vezo hi hashshesua shenneesra battora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 7)</small> "et ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa hashshesua" kelomar beriyya shennolda shesua lishte behemot: 
Vechen behema shennimtza bah demut of af al pi shehu of tahor hare ze asur baachila. lo huttar min hannimtza babbehema ella ma sheyyesh lo parsa: 
En lecha bechol behema vechayya shebbaolam shemmuttar baachila chutz measeret hamminin hammenuyin battora. shelosha mine behema vehem. shor se veez. veshiva mine chayya. ayyal utzevi veyachmur veakko vedishon uteo vazamer. hem uminehen kegon shor habbar vehammeri shehen mimmin hashshor. vechol haasara minin uminehem maale gera umafris parsa. lefichach mi shehu makkiran eno tzarich livdok lo bappe velo baraglayim: 
Af al pi shekkullan muttarin baachila tzerichin anu lehavedil ben behema tehora vechayya tehora. shehachayya chelbah muttar vedamah taun kissuy vehabbehema hattehora chelbah becharet veen damah taun kissuy: 
Vesimane chayya mippi hashshemua hen. kol min shehu mafris parsa umaale gera veyesh lo karnayim mefutztzalot kegon haayyal hare ze chayya tehora bevadday. vechol sheen karnav mefutztzalot im hayu karnav keruchot kekarne hashshor vacharukot kekarne haez veyihye hecharak muvla bahen vahadurot kekarne hatztzevi hare zo chayya tehora. uvilvad sheyyihye bakkarnayim shelosha simanin ellu keruchot charukot vahadurot: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemin sheeno makkiro aval shiva mine chayya haamurin battora im haya makkir otan afillu lo matza lo karnayim hare ze ochel chelbo vechayyav lechassot damo: 
Shor habbar min behema hu vehakkeresh af al pi sheen lo ella keren achat hare hu chayya. vechol sheyyistappek lecha im hu min chayya o min behema chelbo asur veen lokin alav umechassin et damo: 
Kilayim habba mibbehema tehora im chayya tehora hu hannikra kevi. chelbo asur veen lokin alav umechassin et damo. veen min tame mitabber mimmin tahor kelal: 
Simane of tahor lo nitparesh min hattora. ella mana minyan temeim bilvad ushear mine haof muttarin. vehamminyan haasurin arbaa veesrim hen. veellu hen. 1) nesher. 2) peres. 3) azniyya. 4) daa vehi haraa haamura bemishne tora. 5) ayya vehi haddayyah haamura bemishne tora. 6) min haayya shekken katuv bah leminah michlal shehu shene minin. 7) orev. 8) zarzir shekken neemar beorev lemino lehavi et hazzarzir. 9) yaana. 10) tachmas. 11) shachaf. 12) netz. 13) vesharneka vehu min hannetz shekken katuv bo leminehu. yad) kos. 15) shalach. 16) yanshuf. 17) tinshemet. 18) kaat. 19) rachama. 20) chasida. ka) haanafa. 22) min haanafa shekken neemar bah leminah. 23) hadduchifat. kad) haatallef: 
Kol mi shehu baki beminin ellu uvishmotehen hare ze ochel of sheeno mehem veeno tzarich bedika. veof tahor neechal bemasoret. vehu sheyyihye davar pashut beoto makom shezze of tahor. veneeman tzayyad lomar of ze hittir li rabbi hatztzayyad. vehu sheyyuchzak oto tzayyad shehu baki beminin ellu uvishmotehen: 
Mi sheeno makkiran veeno yodea shemotehen bodek besimanin ellu shennatnu chachamim. kol of shehu dores veochel beyadua shehu meellu hamminin vetame. vesheeno dores veochel im yesh bo echad mishshelosha simanin ellu hare ze of tahor. veellu hen. etzba yetera. o zefek vehi hammura. o shehaya kurkevano niklaf beyad: 
Lefi sheen bechol ellu hamminin haasurin min sheeno dores veyesh bo echad mishshelosha simanin ellu chutz mipperes veazniyya uferes veazniyya enan metzuyin beyishshuv ella bemidbarot iyye hayyam harchokot ad meod shehen sof hayyishshuv: 
Haya hakkurkevan niklaf besakkin veeno niklaf beyad veen bo siman acher af al pi sheeno dores hare ze safek. haya chazak vedavek vehinnicho bashshemesh venitrappa veniklaf beyad hare ze muttar: 
Amru haggeonim shemmasoret hi bidehem sheen morin lehattir of habba besiman echad ella im haya oto siman sheyyikkalef kurkevano beyad. aval im eno niklaf beyad af al pi sheyyesh lo zefek o etzba yetera meolam lo hittiruhu: 
Kol of shecholek et raglav keshemmotchin lo chut shetayim lechan ushetayim lechan. o shekkolet min haavir veochel baavir. hare ze dores vetame. vechol hashshochen im hattemeim venidme lahem hare ze tame: 
Umine chagavim shehittira tora shemona. veellu hen. 1) chagav. 2) min chagav vehu harazvanit. 3) chargol. 4) umin chargol vehu artzuveya. 5) arbe. 6) umin arbe vehi tzipporet keramim. 7) salam. 8) umin salam vehi yochana yerushalmit: 
Mi shehu baki bahen uvishmotehen ochel. vehatztzayyad neeman alehen keof. vmi sheeno baki bahen bodek besimanin. ushelosha simanin yesh bahen. kol sheyyesh lo arba raglayim. vearba kenafayim shechofot rov orech gufo verov hekkef gufo. veyesh lo shene keraayim lenatter bahem hare ze min tahor. veaf al pi sherosho aroch veyesh lo zanav im haya shemo chagav tahor: 
Mi sheen lo achshav kenafayim o keraayim o sheen lo kenafayim hachofin et rubbo veatid legaddel otan achar zeman kesheyyagdil hare ze muttar meatta: 
Uvedagim shene simanin. senappir vekaskeset. usenappir hu shepporeach bo. vekaskeset hi haddevuka bechol gufo. vechol sheyyesh lo kaskeset yesh lo senappir. en lo achshav uchesheyyagdil yihye lo o sheyyesh lo kaskeset keshehu bayyam uchesheyyaale yashshir kaskassav hare ze muttar. umi sheen lo kaskassim hachofin et kullo muttar. afillu en bo ella senappir achat vekaskeset achat hare ze muttar:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 2:
Mikkelal shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 6)</small> "vechol behema mafreset parsa veshosaat shesa shete ferasot maalat gera" shomea ani shekkol sheenah maalat gera umafreset parsa asura. velav habba mikkelal ase ase hu. uvegamal uvachazir uvearnevet uveshafan neemar <small>(Vayikra 11 4)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 7)</small> "et ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa" vegomer hare lamadta shehen belo taase veaf al pi sheyyesh bahen siman echad. vechol shekken shear behema temea vechayya temea sheen bah siman kelal sheissur achilatam belo taase yeter al ase habba mikkelal otah tochlu: 
Lefichach kol haochel mibbesar behema vechayya temea kezayit loke min hattora. ben sheachal min habbasar ben sheachal min hachelev. lo chillek hakkatuv bitmeim ben besaram lechelbam: 
Haadam af al pi shenneemar bo <small>(Bereshit 2 7)</small> "vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya" eno mikkelal mine chayya baalat parsa lefichach eno belo taase. vehaochel mibbesar haadam o mechelbo ben min hachay ben min hammet eno loke. aval asur hu baase shehare mana hakkatuv shivat mine chayya veamar bahen <small>(Vayikra 11 2)</small> "zot hachayya asher tochlu" ha kol shehu chutz mehen lo tochlu velav habba mikkelal ase ase: 
Haochel kezayit mibbesar of tame loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 13)</small> "veet elle teshakketzu min haof lo yeachlu". vahare avar al ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 11)</small> "kol tzippor tehora tochelu" ha temea lo tochlu. vechen haochel kezayit middag tame loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 11)</small> "vesheketz yihyu lachem" <small>(Vayikra 11 11)</small> "mibbesaram lo tochelu". veavar al ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 9)</small> "kl asher lo senappir vekaskeset tochelu" mikkelal shemmi sheen lo senappir vekaskeset lo yeachel. ha lamadta shekkol haochel dag tame o behema vechayya temea o of tame bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase: 
Chagav tame hare hu bichlal sheretz haof vehaochel kezayit mishsheretz haof loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 19)</small> "kol sheretz haof tame hu lachem lo yeachelu". vee zehu sheretz haof kegon zevuv o yattush vetzira udevora vechayyotze bahen: 
Haochel kezayit mishsheretz haaretz loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 41)</small> "vechol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz sheketz hu lo yeachel". vee zehu sheretz haaretz kegon nechashim veakrabbim vechifshit venaddal vechayyotze bahen: 
Ushemona sheratzim haamurim battora shehen <small>(Vayikra 11 29)</small> "hachled vehaachbar vehatztzav" <small>(Vayikra 11 30)</small> "vehaanaka vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet vehattinshemet" haochel mibbesaram kaadasha loke. shiur achilatan keshiur tumatan. vechullam mitztarfin ze im ze bechaadasha: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheachal mehen achar mitatan. aval hachotech evar min hachay min echad mehen vaachalo eno loke alav ad sheyyihye bo kezayit basar. vechullan mitztarfin lichzayit. achal evar shalem min hashsheretz achar shemmet eno loke ad sheyyihye bo kaadasha: 
Dam shemona sheratzim uvesaran mitztaref lechaadasha vehu sheyyihye haddam mechubbar labbasar. vechen dam hannachash mitztaref livsaro lichzayit veloke alav lefi sheen besaro chaluk middamo. veaf al pi sheeno metamme. vechen kol kayyotze bo mishshear sheratzim sheenan metammein: 
Dam sheratzim shepparash uchenaso vaachalo loke alav bichzayit. vehu sheyyatru bo mishshum ochel sheretz. aval im hitru bo mishshum ochel dam patur. sheen chayyavin ella al dam behema chayya veof: 
Kol hashshiurin umachlekotam halacha lemoshe missinay: 
Haochel kezayit mishsheretz hammayim loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 43)</small> "al teshakketzu et nafshotechem bechol hashsheretz hashshoretz velo tittammeu bahem". hare kalal belav ze sheretz haaretz vesheretz haof vesheretz hammayim. e zehu sheretz hammayim ellu habberiyyot hakketannot kemo hattolaim vehaaluka shebbammayim vehabberiyyot haggedolot beyoter shehen chayyot hayyam. kelalo shel davar kol sheeno betzurat haddagim lo dag tame velo dag tahor kegon kelev hammayim vehaddalfon vehatztzefardea vechayyotze bahen: 
Ellu hamminin shennivrain beashpot uvegufe hannevelot kegon rimma vetolaat vechayyotze bahen sheenan nivrain mizzachar unekeva ella min haggelalim shehisrichu vechayyotze bahen hen hannikrain romes al haaretz. vehaochel mehen kezayit loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 44)</small> "velo tetammeu et nafshotechem bechol hashsheretz haromes al haaretz" veaf al pi sheen parin veravin. aval <small>(Vayikra 11 41 42)</small> "hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz" hu sheppare verave mizzachar unekeva: 
Ellu hamminin hannivrain beferot uvemaachalot im parshu veyatzu laaretz af al pi shechazru letoch haochel mi sheachal mehen kezayit loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 42)</small> "lechol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz" leesor ellu shepparshu laaretz. aval im lo parshu muttar leechol happeri vehattolaat shebbetocho: 
Bamme devarim amurim shehitlia haochel achar shenneekar min haaretz. aval im hitlia vehu mechubbar. otah hattolaat asura keillu persha laaretz sheal haaretz nivret velokin aleha. veim safek asura. lefichach kol mine perot sheddarkan lehatelia keshehen mechubbarin lo yochal ad sheyyivdok happeri mittocho shemma yesh bo tolaat. veim shaha happeri achar shenneekar shenem asar chodesh ochel belo bedika sheen tolaat shebbo mitkayyemet shenem asar chodesh: 
Parshu laavir velo nagu laaretz. o shepparshu miktzatan laaretz. o shepparshu achar shemmetu. o shennimtzet tolaat al haggarina mibbifnim. o sheyyatzu mittoch haochel letoch ochel acher. kol ellu asurin missafek veen lokin alehen: 
Tolaat hannimtzet bime haddagim uvammoach shebberosh habbehema vehannimtzet babbasar asura. aval dag maliach shehitlia hare hattolaat shebbo mutteret. shehen keferot shehitliu achar shenneekru min haaretz shemmuttar leachlan kullan keachat battolaat shebbetochan. vechen hammayim shebbakkelim shehishritzu hare otan sheratzim muttar lishtotan im hammayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 9)</small> "vechol asher lo senappir vekaskeset bammayim bayyammim uvannechalim otam tochelu". kelomar bammayim uvayyammim uvannechalim hu sheatta ochel et sheyyesh lo veen atta ochel et sheen lo. aval bechelim ben sheyyesh lo ben sheen lo muttar: 
Sheretz hammayim hannivra bevorot uveshichin uvimarot hoil veenan mayim novin vahare hen atzurim hare hen kemayim shebbechelim umuttar. veshoche veshote veeno nimna veaf al pi shebbolea bishat shetiyya meotan hashsheratzim haddakkim: 
Bamme devarim amurim shello parshu mimmekom beriyyatan. aval im perash hashsheretz af al pi shechazar letoch hakkeli o letoch habbor asur. parash ledafne hechavit vechazar venafal letoch hammayim o letoch hashshechar muttar. vechen im parash ledafne habbor o hammeara vechazar lammayim muttar: 
Hamesannen et hayyayin o et hachometz o et hashshechar veachal et hayyavchushim o et hayyattushin vehattolaot shessinnen loke mishshum sheretz hammayim o mishshum sheretz haof (vesheretz hammayim) afillu chazar lakkeli achar shessinnenan shehare parshu mimmekom beriyyatan. aval im lo sinnenan shote veeno nimna kemo shepperashnu: 
Ze sheamarnu beferek ze haochel kezayit. kesheachal kezayit mibberiyya gedola o shetztzeref meat mibberiyya zo umeat mibberiyya zo shebbeminah ad sheyyochal kezayit. aval haochel beriyya temea bifne atzmah kullah hare ze loke min hattora. vaafillu hayta pechuta min hachardal. ben sheachalah meta ben sheachalah chayya. vaafillu sarcha habberiyya venishtannet tzuratah hoil vaachalah kullah loke: 
Nemala shechasera afillu achat meragleha eno loke aleha ella bichzayit. lefichach haochel zevuv shalem o yattush shalem ben chay uven met loke mishshum sheretz haof: 
Hare shehayta habberiyya mishsheretz haof umishsheretz hammayim umishsheretz haaretz kegon shehayu lah kenafayim vehi mehallechet al haaretz kishar sheratzim vehayta rava bammayim vaachalah loke shalosh malkiyyot. veim hayta yeter al ze min hamminin shennivreu beferot loke aleha arba malkiyyot. veim hayta min hamminin shepparin veravin loke chamesh. veim hayta mikkelal of tame yeter al heyotah mishsheretz haof loke aleha shesh malkiyyot. mishshum of tame. umishshum sheretz haof. umishshum sheretz haaretz. umishshum sheretz hammayim. umishshum romes al haaretz. umishshum tolaat happerot. ben sheachalah kullah ben sheachal mimmenna kezayit. lefichach haochel nemala happorachat haggedela bammayim loke chamesh malkiyyot: 
Rissek nemalim vehevi achat shelema vetzerfah leellu shennitrasseku venaasa hakkol kezayit vaachalo loke shesh malkiyyot. chamesh mishshum hannemala haachat veachat mishshum kezayit minnivlat hattemeim:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 3:
Kol maachol hayyotze mimmin min hamminin haasurin shellokin al achilatan hare oto hammaachol asur baachila min hattora. kegon chalev behema vechayya hattemeim uvetze of vedag hattemeim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 16)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 15)</small> "veet bat hayyaana" zo betzatah. vehu haddin lechol haasur keyaana ulechol haddevarim haddomin levetza: 
Chalev haadam muttar baachila af al pi shebbesar haadam asur baachila. uchevar bearnu shehu baase: 
Devash devorim udevash tzeraim muttar mippene sheeno mittamtzit gufan ella konsin oto min haasavim betoch pihen umekiin oto bakkavveret kede sheyyimtzeu oto leechol mimmennu bimot haggeshamim: 
Af al pi shechalev adam muttar asru chachamim legadol linok oto min hashshadayim ella cholevet ishsha letoch hakkeli veshote. vegadol sheyyanak min hashshad keyonek sheretz umakkin oto makkat mardut: 
Yonek tinok veholech afillu arba o chamesh shanim. veim gemaluhu ufarash shelosha yamim o yeter mechamat buryo lo mechamat chalyo eno chozer veyonek. vehu sheggemaluhu achar 24 chodesh. aval betoch zeman ze afillu gemaluhu chodesh o shenayim muttar lachazor velinok ad sof 24 chodesh: 
Af al pi shechalev behema temea uvetze of tame asurin min hattora en lokin alehem shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 8)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 8)</small> "mibbesaram lo tochelu" al habbasar hu loke veeno loke. al habbetza veal hechalav. vahare haochel otan keochel chatzi shiur shehu asur min hattora veeno loke aval makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Yerae li shehaochel betze dagim temeim hannimtzaim bimehem keochel kirve dagim temeim veloke min hattora. vechen betze haof hattame hatteluyot beeshkol sheadayin lo parshu venigmeru. haochel otan loke keochel bene meayim shellahen: 
Betzat of tame shehitchil haefroach lehitrakkem bah vaachalo loke mishshum ochel sheretz haof. aval betzat haof tahor shehitchil haefroach lehitrakkem bah vaachalah makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Nimtza aleha koret dam. im al hachelbon zorek et haddam veochel et hashshear. veim al hachelmon asura kullah. betza hammuzeret hannefesh hayyafa tochlenna: 
Efroach shennolad af al pi shello nitpattechu enav muttar leachlo. behema tehora shennitrefa chalavah asur kachalev behema temea. vechen betzat of tahor shennitraf kevetzat of tame veasur: 
Efroach shennolad mibbetzat terefa muttar sheen mino tame. haya haof sefek terefa kol habbetzim shetteled baarema rishona mashhin otan. im taana arema sheniyya vehitchila leled hutteru harishonot sheim hayta terefa lo hayta yoledet od. veim lo yalda hare hen asurot: 
Chalev behema temea eno nikpe veomed kachalev hattehora. veim nitarev chalev temea bachalev behema tehora keshettaamid oto yaamod chalev hattehora veyetze chalev hattuma im hakkom shel gevina: 
Umippene ze yitten haddin shekkol chalav hannimtza beyad akkum asur shemma erev bo chalev behema temea. ugevinat haakkum mutteret sheen chalev behema temea mitgabben. aval bime chachme mishna gazru al gevinat haakkum vaasarum mippene shemmaamidin otah beor keva shel shechitatan shehi nevela. veim tomar vahalo or hakkeva davar katan hu ad meod bechalav sheamad bo velamma lo yibbatel bemiuto. mippene shehu hammaamid haggevina. vehoil vedavar haasur hu sheheemid hare hakkol asur kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Gevina shemmaamidin otah haakkum baasavim o beme perot kegon seraf hatteenim vahare hen nikkarin baggevina horu miktzat haggeonim shehi asura. shekkevar gazru al kol gevinat haakkum ben sheheemiduha bedavar asur ben sheheemiduha bedavar hammuttar gezera mishshum shemmaamidin otah bedavar haasur: 
Haochel gevinat haakkum o chalav shechalavo akkum veen yisrael roehu makkin oto makkat mardut. hachema shel akkum miktzat haggeonim hittiruha shehare lo gazru al hachema vachalev hattemea eno omed. umiktzat haggeonim asaruha mippene tzichtzuche chalav sheyyishshaer bah. shehare hakkom shebbachema eno meorav im hachema kede sheyyibbatel bemiuto. vechol chalav shellahen choshshin lo shemma ervu bo chalev behema temea: 
Yerae li sheim lakach chema min haakkum uvishshelah ad shehalchu lahen tzichtzuche chalav hare zo mutteret. sheim tomar nitarvu imman venitbashshelu kullan batlu bemiutam. aval hachema shebbishshelu otah akkum asura mishshum giule akkum kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Yisrael sheyyashav betzad haeder shel nachri uva hannachri vehevi lo chalav min haeder af al pi sheyyesh baeder behema temea hare zo muttar. veaf al pi shello raa oto cholev. vehu sheyyachol liroto keshehu cholev kesheyyaamod. shehannachri mityare lachalov min hattemea shemma yaamod veyire oto: 
Betza sheshshene rasheha kaddin o sheshshene rasheha chaddin. o shehaya chelmon mibbachutz vechelbon mibbifnim beyadua shehu betzat of tame. roshah echad kad veroshah echad chad vechelbon mibbachutz vechelmon mibbifnim. efshar shehi betzat of tame veefshar shehi betzat of tahor. lefichach shoel latztzayyad yisrael shemmochrah. im amar lo shel of peloni hu veof tahor hu somech alav. veim amar shel of tahor velo amar lo shemo eno somech alav: 
Lefichach en lokchim betzim min haakkum ella im haya makkir otan veyesh lo bahen teviut ayin shehen betze of peloni hattahor. veen choshshin lahen shemma hen betze terefa o betze nevela. veen lokchin min haakkum betza terufa kelal: 
Betze dagim simanehem kesimane betze haof. im hayu shene rasheha kaddin o chaddin temea. echad kad veechad chad shoel leyisreeli hammocher. im amar lo ani melachtim vehotzetim middag tahor ochel al piv. veim amar lo tehorin hem eno neeman ella im ken haya adam shehuchzak bechashrut: 
Vechen en lokchin gevina vachatichat dag sheen bah siman ella miyyisreeli shehuchzak bechashrut. aval beeretz yisrael keshehayta rubbah yisrael lokchin mikkol yisreeli shebbah. vehechalav lokchin oto mikkol yisrael mikkol makom: 
Hakkovesh dagim temeim tziran asur. aval tzir chagavim temeim muttar mippene sheen bahem lachluchit. lefichach en lokchin tzir min haakkum ella im ken haya bo dag tahor meshotet bo afillu dag echad: 
Akkum shehevi areva melea chaviyyot petuchot shel tzir vedag echad tahor beachat mehem kullan muttarot. hayu setumot patach achat venimtza bah dag tahor sheniyya venimtza bah tahor kullan muttarot. vehu sheyyihye rosho shel dag ushedero kayyam kede sheyyehe nikkar shehu dag tahor. lefichach en lokchin dagim merotzatzin meluchin min haakkum vehem hannikraim tarit terufa. veim haya rosh haddag ushedero nikkar af al pi shehu merotzatz muttar likkach oto min haakkum: 
Akkum shehevi garav shel chatichot dag shechittuchan shave vehen nikkarin shekkullan middag echad umatza bachaticha achat mehen kaskassin hare kullan muttarot:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 4:
Haochel kezayit mibbesar behema shemmeta o chayya shemmeta o of shemmet loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lo tochlu chol nevela". vechol shello nishchata karauy hare zo meta. uvehilchot hashshechita yitbaer hashshechita shehi karauy vesheenah karauy: 
En asur mishshum nevela ella minim tehorim bilvad mippene shehen reuyin lishchita veim nishchatu shechita keshera yihyu muttarin baachila. aval minin temein sheen shechita moelet bahen ben shennishchata karauy ben shemmeta kedarkah ben shechatach basar min hachay mimmenna vaachalo eno loke mishshum nevela uterefa ella mishshum ochel besar temea: 
Haochel of tahor chay kol shehu loke mishshum ochel nevela veaf al pi sheen bo kezayit hoil vaachalo kullo. veim achalo achar shemmet ad sheyyihye bo kezayit. veaf al pi sheen bechullo basar kezayit hoil veyesh bechullo kezayit chayyav alav mishshum nevela: 
Haochel kezayit mibbesar nefel behema tehora loke mishshum ochel nevela. veasur leechol min habbehema shennolda ad lel shemini shekkol shello shaha shemona yamim bivhema hare ze kenefel. veen lokin alav. veim noda lo shekkalu lo chodashav babbeten veachar kach nolad shehen tisha chodashim livhema gassa vachamishsha ledakka hare ze muttar bayyom shennolad: 
Hashshilya sheyyatzat im havvalad asura baachila vehaochlah patur sheenah basar: 
Haochel kezayit mibbesar behema o chayya o of tehorim shennitrefu loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu lakkelev tashlichun oto". terefa haamura battora zo shettarfa otah chayyat hayyaar kegon ari venamer vechayyotze bahen. vechen of shettaraf oto of haddores kegon netz vechayyotze bo. veen atta yachol lomar shettarfa otah vehemita otah sheim meta hare hi nevela. uma li meta mechamat atzmah o hikka besayif vehemitah o shevarah ari vehemitah. ha eno medabber ella beshennitrefa velo meta: 
Veim hatterefa shello meta asura yachol im ba zeev vegarar haggedi beraglo o biznavo o beazno veradaf adam vehitztzilo mippiv yihye asur shehare nitraf talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "uvasar bassade terefa" vegomer <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "lakkelev tashlichun oto". ad sheyyaase otah basar haruya lakkelev. ha lamadta shehatterefa haamura battora hi shettarfa oto chayyat hayyaar veshavra otah venata lamut vaadayin lo meta. af al pi shekkadam ushechatah kodem shettamut hare zo asura mishshum terefa hoil vei efshar shettichye mimmakka zo habbaa aleha: 
Nimtzeta lamed shehattora asra hammeta vehi hannevela. veasra hannota lamut mechamat makkoteha veaf al pi sheadayin lo meta vehi hatterefa. ucheshem shello tachalok bemita ben meta mechamat atzmah ben shennafla vameta ben shechanakah ad shemmeta ben shedderasatta chayya vaharagatta. kach lo tachalok benota lamut ben shetterafatta chayya ushevaratta ben shennafla min haggag venishtabberu rov tzaloteha ben shennafla venitrasseku evareha ben shezzarak bah chetz venakav libbah o reatah ben shebba lah choli mechamat atzmah venakav libbah o reatah o shibber rov tzaloteha vechayyotze bahen. hoil vehi nota lamut mikkol makom hare zo terefa. ben shehaya haggorem bide basar vadam ben shehaya bide shamayim. im ken lamma neemar battora <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "terefa". dibber hakkatuv bahove. sheim lo tomar ken lo teaser ella otah shennitrefa bassade aval im nitrefa bechatzer lo teaser. ha lamadta sheen hakkatuv medabber ella bahove: 
Veinyan hakkatuv shehannota lamut mechamat makkoteha vei efshar lah lichyot mechamat makka zo asura. mikkan amru chachamim ze hakkelal kol sheen kamoha chayya terefa. uvehilchot shechita yitbaer e ze choli ose otah terefa vee ze choli en ose otah terefa: 
Vechen hachotech basar min hachay min hattehorim hare oto habbasar terefa vehaochel mimmennu kezayit loke mishshum ochel terefa. shehare basar ze mibbehema shello nishchata velo meta. ma li tarfa otah chayya ma li chatachah besakkin ma li bechullah ma li bemiktzatah. hare hu omer <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu" kevan shennaaset habbehema basar bassade hare hi terefa: 
Behema shehi chola mechamat shettashash kochah venatta lamut hoil velo era makka beevar meevareha hammemitim otah hare zo mutteret. shello asra tora ella keen terefat chayyat hayyaar shehare asa bah makka hammemita otah: 
Af al pi shehi mutteret gedole hachachamim lo hayu ochlin mibbehema shemmemaharin veshochatin otah kede shello tamut veaf al pi sheppirkesa besof shechita. vedavar ze en bo issur ella kol harotze lehachamir al atzmo bedavar ze hare ze meshubbach: 
Hashshochet behema chayya veof velo yatza mehen dam hare ellu muttarin veen omrin shemma metim hayu. vechen hashshochet et habberia velo pirkesa hare zo mutteret. aval hamesukkenet vehi kol shemmaamidin otah veenah omedet af al pi shehi ochelet maachal beriot im shechatah velo pirkesa kelal hare zo nevela velokin aleha. veim pirkesa hare zo mutteret. vetzarich sheyyihye happirkus besof hashshechita. aval bitchillatah eno moil: 
Ketzad hu happirkus bivhema dakka uvechayya gassa vedakka. ben sheppashta yadah vehechezira o sheppashta raglah af al pi shello hechezira o shekkefafa raglah bilvad hare ze pirkus umuttar. aval im pashta yadah velo hecheziratah hare zo asura sheen zo ella hotzaat nefesh bilvad. uvivhema gassa echad hayyad veechad haregel ben sheppashta velo kaffa ben kaffa velo pashta hare zo pirkus umutteret. veim lo pashta lo yad velo regel velo kaffa kelal hare zo nevela. uveof afillu lo rifref ella beeno velo kishkesh ella biznavo hare ze pirkus: 
Hashshochet et hamesukkenet ballayla velo yada im pirkesa o lo pirkesa hare zo sefek nevela vaasura: 
Kol issurin shebbattora en mitztarfin ze im ze chutz meissure nazir kemo sheyyitbaer sham. lefichach hallokeach meat chelev umeat dam umeat besar behema temea umeat besar nevela umeat besar dag tame umeat besar of tame vechayyotze baellu mishshear haissurin vetzeref min hakkol kezayit vaachalo eno loke vedino kedin ochel chatzi shiur: 
Kol hannevelot mitztarfot zo im zo. unevela mitztarefet im terefa. vechen kol behema vechayya hattemeim mitztarfin ze im ze. aval besar nevela im besar behema temea en mitztarfin. ketzad. hallokeach minnivlat hashshor venivlat hatztzevi venivlat hattarnegol vekibbetz min hakkol kezayit basar vaachalo loke. vechen im kibbetz chatzi zayit minnivlat behema tehora vachatzi zayit min hatterefa o chatzi zayit mibbesar nevela vachatzi zayit mibbasar min hachay min hattehora vaachalo loke. vechen besar haggamal vehachazir vehaarnevet shekkibbetz mikkullam kezayit vaachalo loke. aval im tzeref chatzi zayit minnivlat hashshor vachatzi zayit mibbesar haggamal enan mitztarfin. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen behema temea veof tame o dag tame en besar shenehen mitztaref. lefi shehen shene shemot. shehare kol echad mehen belav bifne atzmo kemo shebbearnu. aval kol haofot hattemein mitztarfin kemo shemmitztarfin kol behema vechayya hattemein. ze hakkelal kol sheissuran belav echad mitztarfin. bishne lavin en mitztarfin. chutz minnevela uterefa hoil vehatterefa techillat nevela hi: 
Haochel minnevela uterefa o mibbehema vechayya hattemeim min haor umin haatzamot umin haggidim umin hakkarnayim umin hattelafayim umin hatztzipparnayim shel of mimmekomot shemmevatzbetz mishsham haddam kesheyyechatchu umin hashshilya shellahen af al pi shehu asur hare ze patur mippene sheellu enan reuyin laachila veen mitztarfin im habbasar lichzayit: 
Kevat hannevela vekevat hattemea mutteret mippene shehi kishar tinnofet shebbagguf. ulefichach muttar lehaamid haggevina bekevat shechitat haakkum uvekevat behema vechayya temea. aval or hakkeva hare hu kishar hammeayim veasur: 
Or habba keneged panav shel chamor muttar baachila mippene shehu kemo happeresh ume raglayim shehen muttarin. yesh orot shehen kevasar vehaochel mehen kezayit keochel min habbasar. vehu kesheyyochal otan keshehen rakkim: 
Veellu sheorotehen kivsaran. or haadam veor hachazir shel yishshuv veor chatoteret shel gamal shello taanu alav massa meolam velo higgia lemassa sheadayin hi rakka veor bet habboshet veor shettachat haalya veor hashshalil veor haanaka vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet. kol ellu haorot keshehen rakkot hare hen kevasar lechol davar ben leissur achila ben letuma: 
Neemar beshor hanniskal <small>(Shemot 21 28)</small> "velo yeachel et besaro". veheach haya efshar leachlo achar shenniskal vahare hu nevela. ella lo ba hakkatuv ella lehodiacha shekkevan shennigmar dino liskila neesar venaasa kivhema temea. veim kadam ushechato shechita keshera hare ze asur bahanaya. veim achal mibbesaro kezayit loke. vechen kesheyyissakel lo yimmacher velo yittenennu lichlavim velo leakkum lechach neemar lo yeachel et besaro. uferesh shel shor hanniskal muttar bahanaa. noda shehu patur missekila achar shennigmar dino kegon shehuzemu haedim yetze veyire baeder. veim noda achar shenniskal hare ze muttar bahanaya:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 5:
Mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Devarim 12 23)</small> "lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar" leesor evar shennechtach min hachay. veal evar min hachay hu omer lenoach <small>(Bereshit 9 4)</small> "ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu". veissur evar min hachay noheg bivhema chayya veof bithorim aval lo bitmeim: 
Echad evar sheyyesh bo basar vegidim vaatzamot kegon hayyad veharegel. veechad evar sheen bo etzem kegon hallashon vehabbetzim vehattechol vehakkelayot vechelev vechayyotze bahen. ella shehaevar sheen bo etzem ben shechatach kullo ben shechatach miktzato hare ze asur mishshum evar min hachay. vehaevar sheyyesh bo etzem eno chayyav alav mishshum evar min hachay ad sheyyifrosh kivriyyato basar vegidim vaatzamot. aval im parash min hachay habbasar bilvad chayyav alav mishshum terefa kemo shebbearnu lo mishshum evar min hachay: 
Haochel meevar min hachay kezayit loke vaafillu achal evar shalem im yesh bo kezayit chayyav pachot mikkezayit patur. chatach min haevar kivriyyato basar vegidim vaatzamot kezayit vaachalo loke af al pi sheen bo basar ella kol shehu. aval im hifrid haevar achar shettelasho min hachay vehifrid habbasar min haggidim umin haatzamot eno loke ad sheyyochal kezayit min habbasar levaddo. veen haatzamot vehaggidim mitztarfin bo lichzayit meachar sheshshinna beriyyato: 
Chilleko leevar ze vaachalo meat meat. im yesh bema sheachal kezayit basar chayyav veim lav patur. lakach kezayit min haevar kivriyyato basar vegidim vaatzamot vaachalo af al pi shennechlak befiv bifnim kodem sheyyivlaennu chayyav: 
Talash evar min hachay venitrefa bintilato vaachalo chayyav shetayim. mishshum evar min hachay umishshum terefa shehare shene haissurin bain keachat. vechen hattolesh chelev min hachay vaachalo loke shetayim. mishshum evar min hachay umishshum chelev. talash chelev min hatterefa vaachalo loke shalosh: 
Basar hameduldal bivhema veevar hameduldal bah im eno yachol lachazor velichyot af al pi shello parash ella achar shennishchata asur veen lokin alav. veim meta habbehema roin oto keillu nafal mechayyim. lefichach lokin alav mishshum evar min hachay. aval hayyachol lachazor velichyot im nishchata habbehema hare ze muttar: 
Shamat evar o meacho o dacho kegon habbetzim shemmaach otan o nittekan hare ze eno asur min hattora shehare yesh bo miktzat chayyim. ulefichach en masriach. veaf al pi chen asur leachlo mimminhag shennahagu kol yisrael mikkedem shehare hu dome leevar min hachay: 
Etzem shennishbar im haya habbasar o haor chofe rov avyo shel etzem hannishbar verov hekkef hashshever hare ze muttar. veim yatza haetzem lachutz hare haevar asur. uchesheyyishchot habbehema o haof yachtoch mimmekom hashshever veyashlicho vehashshear muttar. nishbar haetzem vehabbasar chofe et rubbo aval haya oto basar merussas o nitakkel kevasar sheharofe gorro. o shehaya mitlakket harov mimmekomot harebe. o shehaya habbasar shealav nekavim nekavim. o shennisdak habbasar. o shennikdar kemin tabbaat. o shennigrar habbasar millemala ad shello nishar min habbasar ella kiklifa. o shennitakkel habbasar millematta meal haetzem shennishbar ad shennimtza habbasar hachofe eno nogea baetzem. bechol ellu morin leissur ad sheyyitrappe habbasar. veim achal mikkol ellu makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Hammoshit yado lime habbehema vechatach min hattechol umin hakkelayot vechayyotze bahen vehinniach hachatichot betoch meeha veachar kach shechatah. hare otan hachatichot asurot mishshum evar min hachay. veaf al pi shehu betoch meeha. aval im chatach min haubbar shebbemeeha velo hotzio veachar kach shechatah hare chatichat haubbar o evaro muttar hoil velo yatza. ubbar shehotzi yado o raglo neesar oto evar leolam ben shechatacho kodem shettishshachet immo ben shechatacho achar shennishchata immo. vaafillu hechezir oto evar lime immo veachar kach nishchat o nolad havvalad vechaya kamma shanim hare oto haevar asur mishshum terefa. shekkol basar sheyyatza chutz limchitztzato neesar kevasar shepparash min hachay shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "uvasar bassade terefa" kevan sheyyatza lemakom shehu lo kesade naasa terefa kemo shebbearnu: 
Hotzi miktzat haevar venishar miktzato bifnim afillu lo nishar ella miuto hayyotze asur veshebbifnim muttar. veim chatach hayyotze min haevar achar shehechziro venishchata. oto sheyyatza bilvad asur ushear haevar muttar. veim lo hechziro vachatacho vehu bachutz. ben shechatacho kodem shechita o achar shechita. mekom hachatach asur. vehu hammakom shenneged haavir. achar sheyyechatech hayyotze chozer vechotech mekom hachatach: 
Kol evar ubbar sheyyatza vachatacho kodem shechita vehu bachutz hare ze evar min hachay velokin alav. vaafillu met haubbar kodem shechita. veim nechtach achar shechita haochlo eno loke vaafillu met. veim meta habbehema veachar kach chatacho haochlo loke mishshum evar min hachay: 
Ubbar shehotzi evar veneesar haevar veachar kach nolad vahare hi nekeva. hechalav shellah asur lishtoto missafek. hoil vehu ba mikkelal haevarin veyesh bah evar echad asur. vahare ze kachalev terefa shennitarev bachalev tehora: 
Hashshochet behema meubberet umatza bah shalil ben chay ben met hare ze muttar baachila. vaafillu shilya mutteret baachila. veshilya sheyyatzat miktzatah veshachat et habbehema. im hayta shilya zo keshura bavvalad ma sheyyatza mimmenna asur vehashshear muttar. veim lo hayta keshura bo kullah asura. shemma shilya zo sheyyatzat miktzatah halach lo valad shehaya bah vevalad ze shennimtza babbeten halcha shilya shello. veen tzarich lomar sheim lo nimtza babbeten valad kelal shehashshilya kullah asura: 
Matza bah ubbar chay af al pi shehu ben tisha chodashim gemurin veefshar sheyyichye eno tzarich shechita ella shechitat immo metaharto. veim hifris al gabbe karka tzarich shechita: 
Kara et habbehema o shachat behema terefa umatza bah ben tisha chay tzarich shechita lehattiro veen shechitat immo moelet lo. veim lo gamru lo chodashav af al pi shehu chay bime hatterefa hare ze asur mippene shehu keevar meimmo. kol ubbar shehotzi rosho vehechziro veachar kach shachat et immo en shechitat immo moelet lo vahare hu keyalud vetzarich shechita:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 6:
Haochel kezayit min haddam bemezid chayyav karet beshogeg mevi chattat kevua. vedavar meforash battora sheeno chayyav ella al dam behema chayya veof bilvad ben temein ben tehorin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 26)</small> "vechol dam lo tochlu bechol moshvotechem laof velabbehema". vechayya bichlal behema shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 4)</small> "zot habbehema asher tochelu shor" vegomer <small>(Devarim 14 5)</small> "ayyal utzevi" vegomer. aval dam dagim vachagavim ushekatzim uremasim vedam haadam en chayyavin alav mishshum dam. lefichach dam dagim vachagavim tehorim muttar leachlo vaafillu kenaso bichli veshatahu muttar. vedam chagavim vedagim temeim asur mishshum shehu tamtzit gufan kachalev behema temea. vedam shekatzim kivsaran kemo shebbearnu: 
Dam haadam asur middivre sofrim im perash. umakkin alav makkat mardut. aval dam hashshinnayim bolo veeno nimna. hare shennashach befat umatza aleha dam gorer et haddam veachar kach ochel shehare perash: 
En chayyavin karet ella al dam hayyotze bishat shechita unechira o hattazat harosh kol zeman sheyyesh bo admumit. veal haddam hakkanus betoch hallev. veal dam hakkaza kol zeman shehu mekalleach veyotze. aval haddam hashshotet bitchillat hakkaza kodem sheyyatchil lekalleach vedam hashshotet besof hakkaza kesheyyatchil haddam lifsok en chayyavin alav vahare hu kedam haevarim. sheddam hakkilluach hu haddam shehannefesh yotza bo: 
Dam hattamtzit vedam haevarin kegon dam hattechol vedam hakkelayot vedam betzim vedam hammitkannes lallev bishat shechita vedam hannimtza bakkaved en chayyavin alav karet. aval haochel mimmennu kezayit loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 3 17)</small> <small>(Vayikra 7 26)</small> "vechol dam lo tochelu". uvechiyyuv karet hu omer <small>(Vayikra 17 11)</small> "ki nefesh habbasar baddam hi" eno chayyav karet ella al haddam shehannefesh yotza bo: 
Hashshalil hannimtza bime habbehema hare damo kedam hayyalud. lefichach haddam hannimtza kanus betoch libbo chayyavin alav karet aval shear damo hare hu kedam haevarin: 
Hallev ben letzali ben likdera koro umotzi et damo veachar kach molcho. veim bishshel hallev velo kerao koro achar shebbishshelo umuttar. veim lo kerao vaachalo eno chayyav alav karet. bamme devarim amurim belev haof sheen bo kezayit dam. aval im haya lev behema chayyav karet shehare yesh bo kezayit middam shebbetoch hallev shechayyavin alav karet: 
Hakkaved im chatachah vehishlichah letoch hachometz o letoch mayim rotchin ad shettitlabben hare zo mutteret levashshel otah achar ken. uchevar nahagu kol yisrael lehavehavah al haur veachar kach mevashshelin otah ben shebbishshelah levaddah ben shebbishshelah im basar acher. vechen minhag pashut sheen mevashshelin hammoach shel rosh velo kolin oto ad shemmehavhavin oto baur: 
Hakkaved shebbishshelah velo hivhavah al haur velo chalatah bechometz o berotchin hare hakkedera kullah asura hakkaved vechol shenitbashshel immah. umuttar litzlot kaved im habbasar beshippud echad vehu shettihye hakkaved lematta. veim avar utzelaah lemala mibbasar hare ze ochlo: 
Hattechol muttar levashshelo afillu im habbasar sheeno dam ella basar haddome ledam. hashshover mifreket behema kodem shettetze nafshah hare haddam nivla baevarim veasur leechol mimmenna basar chay vaafillu chalato. ella ketzad yaase. yachtoch hachaticha veyimlach yafe yafe veachar kach yevashshel o yitzle. uchevar bearnu shehashshochet behema chayya veof velo yatza mehen dam shehen muttarin: 
En habbasar yotze mide damo ella im ken molcho yafe yafe umedicho yafe yafe. ketzad ose. mediach habbasar techilla veachar kach molcho yafe yafe umannicho bemilcho kede hilluch mil. veachar kach medicho yafe yafe ad sheyyetzu hammayim zakkim umashlicho miyyad letoch mayim rotchin aval lo lefoshrin kede sheyyitlabben miyyad velo yetze dam: 
Keshemmolchin habbasar en molchin oto ella bichli menukkav. veen molchin ella bemelach ave kechol haggas. shehammelach dak kekemach yibbala babbasar velo yotzi dam. vetzarich lenappetz habbasar min hammelach veachar kach yedichennu: 
Kol haddevarim haellu levasar shetztzarich levashshelo aval letzali moleach vetzole miyyad. veharotze leechol basar chay molcho yafe yafe umedicho yafe yafe veachar kach yochal. veim chalato bechometz muttar leachlo keshehu chay. umuttar lishtot hachometz shechalato bo sheen hachometz motzi haddam: 
Chometz shechalat bo basar lo yachlot bo paam sheniyya. vachaticha sheheedima betoch hachometz hi vehachometz asurin ad sheyyimlach otah yafe yafe veyitzle. basar shehedim vechen betze behema vechayya biklifa shealehen. vechen haoref shebbo hammizrakim shehen meleim dam. im chatachan umelachan kaddat muttar levashshelan. veim lo chatachan utzelaan beshippud vetzala haoref ufiv lematta o shetztzelaan kullan al haggechalim hare ellu muttarin: 
Rosh habbehema shetztzalahu betannur o bechivshan im talahu uvet shechitato lematta muttar shehaddam yotze veshotet. veim haya bet hashshechita min hatztzad mocho asur. shehaddam mitkabbetz letocho. ushear habbasar sheal haatzamot mibbachutz muttar. hinniach chatmo lematta im hinniach bo gemi o kane kede sheyyishshaer patuach veyetze damo derech chatmo muttar veim lav mocho asur: 
En mannichin keli tachat hatztzali lekabbel memav ad shettichle kol mare admumit shebbo. vechetzad osin. mashlichin letoch hakkeli meat melach umanniach hakkeli ad sheyyitztzale velokeach hashshamnunit shel mala vehammayim shel matta shettachat hashshamnunit asura: 
Pat shechatach aleha basar tzali muttar leachlah sheenah ella shamnunit [1. 2] dagim veofot shemmelachan ze im ze afillu bichli menukkav haddagim asurin shehaddag rafe uvolea dam hayyotze min haof. veen tzarich lomar im malach dag im besar behema o chayya: 
Ofot shehinnichan shelemim umille chalalan basar uvetzim uvishshelan asurot shehare dam yotze letochan veaf al pi shemmelachan yafe yafe. vaafillu haya habbasar shebbetochan shaluk o tzaluy. veim tzelaan hare ellu muttarot af al pi shehabbasar shebbetochan chay vaafillu pihen lemala: 
Bene meayim shemmillean al derech zo bevasar tzaluy o shaluk o shemmillean bevetzim ushelakan o kelaan hare ellu muttarin sheen machazikin dam bivne meayim. vechen horu haggeonim: 
Ofot shettefalan bevatzek utzelaan ben shelemim ben mechuttachin im tefalan besolet gassa afillu hismika hattefela ochel et hattefela mippene shessolet gassa mitpareret veyotze haddam. veim tefalan bekemach chittim shellattan im hayta hattefela levana kemo hakkesef muttar leechol mimmenna veim lav asura. tefalan bishar kemachin im hedimu asurin veim lo hedimu muttarin: 
Sakkin sheshshachat bah asur lachtoch bah roteach ad sheyyelabben hassakkin baur o yashchizenna bemashchezet o yinatzenna bekarka kasha eser peamim. veim chatach bah roteach muttar. vechen eno chotech bah tzenon vechayyotze bo middevarim hacharifim lechattechilla. veim hediach hassakkin o shekkinnechah bichli muttar lachtoch bo tzenon vechayyotze bo aval lo roteach: 
Keara shemmalach bah basar afillu hayta shoa baavar asur leechol bah roteach leolam shekkevar nivla haddam bacharaseha:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 7:
Haochel kezayit chelev bemezid chayyav karet. beshogeg mevi chattat kevua. uveferush amra tora sheeno chayyav ella al shelosha mine behema tehora bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 23)</small> "kol chelev shor vechesev vaez lo tochelu" ben sheachal mechelev shechuta ben sheachal mechelev nevela uterefa shellahen. aval shear behema vechayya ben temea ben tehora chelbah kivsarah. vechen nefel shel shelosha mine behema tehora chelbo kivsaro vehaochel mechelbo kezayit loke mishshum ochel nevela: 
Haochel mechelev nevela uterefa chayyav mishshum ochel chelev umishshum ochel nevela uterefa mittoch shennosaf haissur bivsarah shehaya muttar nosaf al hachelev ulefichach loke shetayim: 
Hashshochet behema umatza bah shalil kol chelbo muttar vaafillu metzao chay mippene shehu keevar mimmenna. veim shalmu lo chodashav umetzao chay af al pi shello hifris al hakkarka veeno tzarich shechita chelbo asur vechayyavin alav karet. umotziin mimmennu kol hachutin vehakkerumot haasurin kishar habbehemot: 
Hoshit yado lime behema vechatach mechelev haubbar shekkalu lo chodashav vehotzio hare ze chayyav alav keillu chatacho mechelev haem atzmah. shehechodashim hen haggormin leissur hachelev: 
Shelosha chalavim hen shechayyavin alehen karet. chelev sheal hakkerev vesheal shete hakkelayot vesheal hakkesalim. aval haalya mutteret baachila. lo nikret chelev ella leinyan karban bilvad kemo shennikreu chalavim kelayot veyoteret hakkaved leinyan karban. kemo sheatta omer <small>(Bereshit 45 18)</small> "chelev haaretz" v<small>(Devarim 32 14)</small> "chelev kilyot chitta" shehu tuvam. ulefi shemmerimin devarim ellu min hakkarban lisrefa lashshem nikreu chelev. sheen shem davar tov ella hammuram lashshem. ulechach neemar bitrumat maaser <small>(Bamidbar 18 30 32)</small> "baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu": 
Chelev sheal hemses vesheal bet hakkosot hu hachelev sheal hakkerev. vechelev shebbeikkere hayerechot mibbifnim chayyavin alav karet vehu hachelev sheal hakkesalim. veyesh sham chelev al hakkeva akom kemo keshet vehu haasur vechut mashuch kemo yeter vehu muttar. chutin shebbachelev asurin veen chayyavin alehen karet: 
Chelev shehabbasar chofe oto muttar. sheal hakkesalim asar hakkatuv lo shebbetoch hakkesalim. vechen chelev sheal hakkelayot neesar velo shebbetoch hakkelayot. veaf al pi ken notel adam loven shebbetoch hakkuleya veachar kach ochel otah veeno tzarich lechattet acharav: 
Yesh kemo shete petilot shel chelev beikkere hammatnayim samuch lerosh hayyarech. keshehabbehema chayya chelev ze nire bammeayim. ucheshettamut yidbak basar bevasar veyitkasse chelev ze veeno nire ad sheyyitparek habbasar min habbasar. veaf al pi chen hare ze asur. sheen ze chelev shehabbasar chofe oto. vechol makom shettimtza bo hachelev tachat habbasar vehabbasar makkif oto mikkol sevivav velo yerae ad sheyyikkara habbasar hare ze muttar: 
Chelev hallev vechelev hammeayim vehen haddakkin hameluppafin kullan muttarin vahare hem keshumman shehu muttar. chutz merosh hammei shessamuch lakkeva shehu techillat bene meayim shetztzarich ligror hachelev shealav vezehu chelev sheal haddakkin sheasur. veyesh min haggeonim sheomer sherosh hammei shetztzarich legarro hu hammei sheyyetze bo hari shehu sof hammeayim: 
Yesh beguf habbehema chutin ukerumot shehen asurin. mehem mishshum chelev umehen mishshum dam. vechol chut o kerum sheasur mishshum <small>(Vayikra 3 17)</small> <small>(Vayikra 7 26)</small> "kol dam lo tochelu" tzarich lenatlo veachar kach yimlach vivashshel habbasar kemo sheamarnu. veim chatacho umelacho eno tzarich lenatlo. vechen letzali (eno tzarich lenatlo). vechol chut o kerum shehu asur mishshum kol chelev ben letzali ben levishshul tzarich lenatlo min habbehema: 
Chamishsha chutin yesh bakkesalim. shelosha min hayyamin ushenayim min hassemol. hashshelosha shemmin hayyamin mitpatztzel kol echad mehem lishnayim shenayim. vehashshenayim shemmin hassemol mitpatztzelin lishlosha shelosha. vechullan mishshum chelev. vechute hattechol vechute hakkelayot mishshum chelev. vechen kerum sheal hattechol ukerum sheal hakkesalim ukerum sheal hakkelayot asurin mishshum chelev. ukerum sheal dad hattechol chayyavin alav karet. ushear hakkerum asur veen chayyavin alav: 
Ushene kerumot yesh lakkuleya. haelyon chayyavin alav karet kachelev sheal hakkuleya. vehattachton hare hu kishar kerumot. vechutin shebbahen asurin veen bahen karet: 
Chute hallev vechute hayyad vechute haoketz vechute hallechi hattachton shebbetzad hallashon mikkan umikkan. vechen hachutin haddakkin shehen betoch chelev haddakkin kemo bet akkavish mesubbachin ze baze. ukerum sheal hammoach shebbakkodkod. ukerum sheal habbetzim. hakkol asurin mishshum dam: 
Betze gedi o tale shello hishlim sheloshim yom muttar levashshelan belo kelifa. leachar sheloshim yom im nire bahen chutin dakkin adummim beyadua shehalach bahem haddam velo yevashshel ad sheyyiklof o ad sheyyechatech veyimallach kemo shebbearnu. veim adayin lo niru bahen chutin haadummim muttarin: 
Vechol bene meayim shehammaachol sovev bachalalan en machazikin bahen dam: 
Yerae li shekkol ellu hachutin vehakkerumot issuran middivre sofrim veim tomar shehen asurin min hattora bichlal <small>(Vayikra 3 17)</small> "kol chelev vechol dam" en lokin alehen ella makkat mardut veyihyu kachatzi shiur shehu asur min hattora veen lokin alav: 
En molchin chalavim im habbasar velo medichin chalavim im basar. vesakkin shechatach bah chalavim lo yachtoch bah basar. ucheli shehediach bo chalavim lo yadiach bo basar. lefichach tzarich hattabbach lehatekin shalosh sakkinin. achat sheshshochet bah. veachat shemmechattech bah basar. veachat shemmechattech bah chalavim: 
Veim derech oto makom sheyyadiach hattabbach habbasar bachanut. tzarich lehatekin lo shene kelim shel mayim echad shemmediach bo basar veechad shemmediach bo chalavim: 
Veasur lattabbach lifrosho chelev hakkesalim al habbasar kede lenaoto. shehakkerum sheal hachelev dak veyitmaech beyad hattabbach veyazuv hachelev veyibbala babbasar. vechol haddevarim haellu asur laasotan. viim naasu lo neusar habbasar. vien makkin et haose ella melammedin oto shello yaase: 
Vechen en molchin et habbasar kodem sheyyasir mimmennu et hakkerumot veet hachutin haasurin. veim malach mesiram achar shennimlechu. vaafillu haya bahen gid hannashe mesiro achar shennimlach umevashshel: 
Vetabbach sheddarko lenakkot habbasar venimtza acharav chut o kerum melammedin oto umazhirin oto shello yezalzel beissurin. aval im nimtza acharav chelev im haya kisora maavirin oto. veim nimtza acharav kezayit chelev afillu bimkomot harebe makkin oto makkat mardut umaavirin oto. mippene shehattabbach neeman al hachelev:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 8:
Gid hannashe noheg bivhema vechayya hattehorin vaafillu binvelot uterefot shellahen. venoheg beshalil uvemukdashin ben kadashim hanneechalim ben kadashim sheenan neechalin. venoheg beyarech shel yamin uveyarech shel semol. veen asur min hattora ella sheal kaf hayyarech bilvad shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 32 33)</small> "asher al kaf hayyarech". aval shear haggid shellemala min hakkaf veshellematta ad sofo vechen chelev sheal haggid eno asur ella middivre sofrim. ushene gidin hen. happenimi hassamuch laetzem asur min hattora. vehaelyon kullo asur middivrehem: 
Haochel miggid hannashe happenimi mimmakom sheal hakkaf loke. veim achal mechelbo o mishshear haggid happenimi o mikkol hachitzon makkin oto makkat mardut. vechamma shiur achila. kezayit. veim achal haggid sheal hakkaf kullo af al pi sheen bo kezayit loke mippene shehu kivriyya bifne atzmah: 
Achal kezayit miggid shel yamin uchezayit miggid shel semol. o sheachal shene gidim kullan. af al pi sheen bahen kezayit loke shemonim. (vechen hu loke al kol gid vegid): 
Haof en bo mishshum gid hannashe mippene sheen lo kaf yarech ella yerecho aroch. veim nimtza of sheyyerecho keyerech habbehema sheyyesh lo kaf gid hannashe shello asur veen lokin alav. vechen behema shekkaf yerechah aroch keshel of gid hannashe shellah asur veen lokin alav: 
Haochel gid hannashe mibbehema vechayya hattemeim patur lefi sheeno noheg bitmea ella bivhema shekkullah mutteret. veeno keochel mishshear gufah sheen haggidim mikkelal habbasar kemo shebbearnu. veim achal mechelev sheal haggid hare ze keochel mibbesarah: 
Haochel gid hannashe shel nevela o shel terefa o shel ola chayyav shetayim. mittoch shennichlal beissur shear gufah shehaya muttar nichlal gam haggid venosaf alav issur acher: 
Hannotel gid hannashe tzarich lechattet acharav ad shello yashir mimmennu kelum. veneeman hattabbach al gid hannashe keshem shenneeman al hachelev. veen lokchin basar mikkol tabbach ella im haya adam kasher umuchzak bechashrut hu sheshshochet leatzmo umocher veneeman: 
Bamme devarim amurim bechutza laaretz. aval beeretz yisrael bizman shekkullah leyisrael lokchin mikkol adam: 
Tabbach hanneeman limkor basar venimtza besar nevela o besar terefa yotze mittachat yado. machazir et haddamim labbealim vmshammetin oto umaavirin oto. veen lo takkana leolam likkach mimmennu basar ad sheyyelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto veyachazir aveda bedavar chashuv o yishchot leatzmo veyotzi terefa leatzmo bemamon chashuv shevvadday asa teshuva belo haarama: 
Hallokeach basar ushelacho beyad echad meamme haaretz hare ze neeman alav. veaf al pi sheeno muchzak bechashrut en choshshin lo shemma yachalif. vaafillu avde yisrael veamhotehen neemanin bedavar ze. aval lo akkum shemma yachalif: 
Eser chanuyyot tesha mochrot besar shechuta veachat mocheret nevelot velakach basar meachat mehen veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach hare ze asur shekkol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dami. aval basar hannimtza mushlach bashshuk hallech achar harov dechol defarish merubba parish. im hayu rov hammochrim akkum asur. veim hayu rov hammochrim yisrael muttar: 
Vechen basar hannimtza beyad akkum veeno yadua mimmi lakach im hayu mochre habbasar yisrael muttar. ze hu din tora. uchevar asru chachamim kol habbasar hannimtza ben bashshuk ben beyad akkum af al pi shekkol hashshochatin vechol hammochrin yisrael. velo od ella hallokeach basar vehinnicho beveto veneelam min haayin asur ella im ken haya lo bo siman o shehaya lo bo teviat ayin vehu makkiro vadday shehu ze o shehaya tzarur vechatum: 
Tala keli male chatichot basar venishbar hakkeli venaflu hachatichot laaretz uva umatza chatichot veen lo bahen siman velo teviat ayin hare ze asur sheyyesh lomar oto basar shehaya bakkeli gerarattu chayya o sheretz veze basar acher hu: 
Gid hannashe muttar bahanaa. lefichach muttar leadam lishloach leakkum yarech sheggid hannashe betochah. venoten lo hayyarech shelema bifne yisrael. veen choshshin shemma yochal mimmenna yisrael ze kodem sheyyinnatel haggid shehare mekomo nikkar. lefichach im hayta hayyarech chatucha lo yittenenna leakkum bifne yisrael ad sheyyittol haggid shemma yochal mimmenna yisrael: 
Kol makom shenneemar battora lo tochal lo tochlu lo yochlu lo yeachel echad issur achila veechad issur hanaa bemashma ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv kederech shepperet lecha binvela shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah" vechachelev shenneemar bo <small>(Vayikra 7 24)</small> "yease lechol melacha". o ad sheyyitparesh battora shebbeal pe shehu muttar bahanaa. kegon shekatzim uremasim vedam veevar min hachay vegid hannashe. shekkol ellu muttarin bahanaa mippi hakkabbala af al pi shehen asurin baachila: 
Kol maachol shehu asur bahanaa im nehena velo achal kegon shemmachar o natan leakkum o lichlavim eno loke. umakkin oto makkat mardut vehaddamim muttarin. vechol davar sheasur baachila umuttar bahanaa af al pi shehu muttar bahanaa asur laasot bo sechora ulechavven melachto bidvarim asurim chutz min hachelev shehare neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 7 24)</small> "yease lechol melacha". lefichach en osin sechora lo binvelot velo bitrefot velo bishkatzim velo birmasim: 
Hatztzayyad shennizdammenu lo chayya o of vedag temeim vetzadan o shennitztzodu lo temeim utehorim muttar lemachran. aval lo yechavven melachto litmeim. umuttar laasot sechora bechalav shechalavo akkum veen yisrael roehu uvigvinot haakkum vechayyotze bahen: 
Ze hakkelal kol sheissuro min hattora asur laasot bo sechora vechol sheissuro middivrehem muttar laasot bo sechora ben bisfeko ben bevaddao:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 9: Basar bechalav asur levashshelo veasur leachlo min hattora. veasur bahanaa. vekovrin oto. veefro asur keefer kol hannikbarin. umi sheyyevashshel mishshenehem kezayit keechad loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo". vechen haochel kezayit mishshenehem mehabbasar vehechalav shennitbashshelu keechad loke veaf al pi shello bishshel:
Lo shatak hakkatuv milleesor haachila ella mippene sheasar habbishshul kelomar vaafillu bishshulo asur veen tzarich lomar achilato. kemo sheshshatak milleesor habbat meachar sheasar bat habbat:

En asur min hattora ella besar behema tehora bachalev behema tehora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 19)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 26)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo". ugedi hu kolel velad hashshor velad hasse velad haez ad sheyyifrot veyomar gedi izzim velo neemar gedi bachalev immo ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove. aval besar behema tehora (shebbishshelo) bachalev behema temea. o besar behema temea (shebbishshelo) bachalev behema tehora muttar levashshel umutteret bahanaya veen chayyavin al achilato mishshum basar bechalav:

Vechen besar chayya veof ben bachalev chayya ben bachalev behema eno asur baachila min hattora lefichach muttar levashshelo umuttar bahanaya. veasur baachila middivre sofrim kede shello yifsheu haam veyavou lide issur basar bechalav shel tora veyochlu besar behema tehora bachalev behema tehora. shehare en mashma hakkatuv ella gedi bachalev immo mammash. lefichach asru kol basar bechalav:
Dagim vachagavim muttar leachlan bechalav. vehashshochet of venimtza bo betzim gemurot muttar leachlan bechalav:

Hameushshan vehamevushshal bechamme teverya vechayyotze bahen en lokin alav. vechen hamevashshel basar beme chalav o bachalev meta o bachalev zachar o shebbishshel dam bechalav patur veeno loke al achilato mishshum basar bechalav. aval hamevashshel besar meta o chelev vechayyotze bahen bechalav loke al bishshulo veeno loke al achilato mishshum basar bechalav. sheen issur basar bechalav chal al issur nevela o issur chelev. sheen kan lo issur kolel velo issur mosif velo issur bat achat:
Hamevashshel shalil bechalav chayyav vechen haochlo. aval hamevashshel shilya o or vegidin vaatzamot veikkere karnayim utelafayim harakkim bechalav patur. vechen haochlan patur:

Basar shennafal letoch hechalav o chalav shennafal letoch habbasar venitbashshel immo shiuro benoten taam. ketzad. chaticha shel basar shennafla likdera rotachat shel chalav. toem hannachri et hakkedera. im amar sheyyesh bah taam basar asura. veim lav mutteret. veotah chaticha asura. bamme devarim amurim shekkadam vehotzi et hachaticha kodem shettiflot chalav shebbala. aval im lo sillek meshaarim otah beshishshim mippene shehechalav shennivla bah veneesar yatza venitarev im shear hechalav:

Nafal chalav letoch kedera shel basar toamin et hachaticha shennafal aleha chalav. im en bah taam chalav hakkol muttar. veim yesh bachaticha taam chalav af al pi sheim tissachet hachaticha lo yishshaer bah taam. hoil veyesh bah atta taam chalav neesra otah chaticha. umeshaarin bechullah im haya bechol sheyyesh bakkedera min hachatichot vehayyarak vehammarak vehattavlin kede shettihye chaticha zo echad mishshishshim min hakkol hachaticha asura vehashshear muttar:

Bamme devarim amurim beshello nier et hakkedera battechilla keshennafal hechalav ella levassof velo kissa. aval im nier mittechilla vead sof o shekkissa mishsheat nefila ad sof hare ze benoten taam. vechen im nafal chalav letoch hammarak o lechol hachatichot velo noda lee ze chaticha nafal. noer et hakkedera kullah ad shettashuv veyitarev hakkol. im yesh bakkedera kullah taam chalav asura veim lav mutteret. im lo nimtza nachri sheyyitom venismoch alav meshaarim beshishshim ben basar letoch chalav ben chalav letoch basar echad mishshishshim muttar pachot mishshishshim asur:
Kedera shebbishshel bah basar lo yevashshel bah chalav. veim bishshel benoten taam:

Hakkechal asur middivre sofrim. sheen basar shenitbashshel bachalev shechuta asur min hattora kemo shebbearnu. lefichach im kerao umerek hechalav shebbo muttar litzloto uleachlo. veim kerao sheti vaerev vetacho bakkotel ad shello nishar bo lachluchit chalav muttar levashshelo im habbasar. uchechal shello kerao ben shel ketanna shello henika ben shel gedola asur levashshelo. veim avar uvishshelo bifne atzmo muttar leachlo. veim bishshelo im basar acher meshaarin oto beshishshim uchechal min hamminyan:

Ketzad. im haya hakkol im hakkechal kemo shishshim bakkechal hakkechal asur vehashshear muttar. veim haya befachot mishshishshim hakkol asur. ben kach uven kach im nafal likdera acheret oser otah umeshaarin bo beshishshim kevarishona. shehakkechal atzmo shenitbashshel naasa kachaticha haasura veen meshaarin bo ella kemot shehu beet shenitbashshel lo kemot shehaya beshaa shennafal:
En tzolin et hakkechal shechatacho [lemala] min habbasar beshippud. veim tzalahu hakkol muttar:
Keva shebbishshelah bechalav shebbah mutteret sheeno chalav ella hare hu ketinnofet shehare yishtanne bammeayim:

Asur lehaamid haggevina beor hakkeva shel shechuta. veim heemid toem et haggevina im yesh bah taam basar asura veim lav mutteret. mippene shehammaamid davar hammuttar hu. shekkevat shechuta hi. veen kan ella issur basar bechalav sheshshiuro benoten taam. aval hammaamid beor kevat nevela uterefa uvehema temea hoil vehammaamid davar haasur bifne atzmo neesra haggevina mishshum nevela lo mishshum basar bechalav. umippene chashash ze asru gevinat akkum kemo shebbearnu:

Habbasar levaddo muttar vehechalav levaddo muttar uvehitarev shenehen al yede bishshul yeasru shenehem. bamme devarim amurim shennitbashshelu shenehem beyachad o shennafal cham letoch cham o tzonen letoch cham. aval im nafal echad mishshenehem vehu cham letoch hashsheni vehu tzonen kolef habbasar kullo shennaga bo hechalav veochel hashshear. veim nafal tzonen letoch tzonen mediach hachaticha veochlah. lefichach muttar litzror basar ugevina bemitpachat achat vehu shello yiggeu ze baze. veim nagu mediach habbasar umediach haggevina veochel:
Maliach sheeno neechol mechamat milcho hare hu keroteach. veim neechol kemot shehu kemo hakkutach eno keroteach:

Of shachut shennafal lechalav o lechutach sheyyesh bo chalav. im chay hu medicho umuttar. veim tzali kolfo. veim hayu bo pelachim pelachim o shehaya metubbal betavlin venafal lechalav o lechutach hare ze asur:
Asur lehaalot haof im haggevina al hashshulchan shehu ochel alav gezera mishshum hergel avera shemma yochal ze im ze. af al pi shehaof bechalav asur middivre sofrim:
Shene achsannain sheenam makkirin ze et ze ochlin al shulchan echad ze besar behema veze gevina mippene sheen ze gas libbo baze kede sheyyochal immo:

En lashin haissa bechalav veim lash kol happat asura mippene hergel avera. shemma yochal bah basar. veen tashin et hattannur bealya. veim tash kol happat asura ad sheyyassik et hattannur shemma yochal bah chalav. veim shinna betzurat happat ad shettihye nikkeret kede shello yochal bah lo basar velo chalav hare ze muttar:
Pat sheafaah im hatztzali vedagim shetztzelaan im habbasar asur leachlan bechalav. keara sheachlu bah basar uvishshelu bah dagim otan haddagim muttar leachlan bechutach:

Sakkin shechatach bah basar tzali vechazar vechatach bah tzenon vechayyotze bo middevarim charifin asur leachlan bechutach. aval im chatach bah basar vechazar vechatach bah kishut o avattiach gored mekom hachatach veochel hashshear bechalav:

En mannichin kad shel melach betzad kad shel kemach mippene sheshshoev mimmennu venimtza mevashshel habbasar bemelach ze sheyyesh bo taam hechalav. aval manniach kad hachometz betzad kad hakkemach sheen hachometz shoev mimmennu:

Mi sheachal gevina o chalav techilla muttar leechol acharav basar miyyad. vetzarich sheyyadiach yadav vikanneach piv ben haggevina uven habbasar. uvema mekanneach piv befat o beferot shelloasan uvolan o poltan. uvakkol mekannechin et happe chutz mittemarim o kemach o yerakot sheen ellu mekannechin yafe:
Bamme devarim amurim bivsar behema o chayya. aval im achal besar of achar sheachal haggevina o hechalav eno tzarich lo kinnuach happe velo netilat yadayim:

Mi sheachal basar battechilla ben besar behema ben besar of lo yochal acharav chalav ad sheyyihye benehen kede shiur seudda acheret vehu kemo shesh shaot mippene habbasar shel ben hashshinnayim sheeno sar bekinnuach:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 10:
Kol issurin sheamarnu hen bemine nefesh chayya. veyesh issurin acherim shel tora bezera haaretz vehen hechadash vechile hakkerem vehattevel vehaarla: 
Hechadash ketzad. kol echad mechamishsha mine tevua bilvad asur leechol mehechadash shello kodem sheyyikkarev haomer betz benisan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 14)</small> "velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu". vechol haochel kezayit chadash kodem hakeravat haomer loke min hattora bechol makom uvechol zeman ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit. ella shebbizman sheyyesh mikdash mishsheyyikkarev haomer huttar hechadash birushalayim. vehammekomot harchokin muttarin achar chatzot sheen bet din mitatztzelin bo ad achar chatzot. uvizman sheen bet hammikdash kol hayyom kullo asur min hattora. uvazzeman hazze bimkomot sheosin shene yamim tovim hechadash asur kol yom 17 benisan ad laerev middivre sofrim: 
Haochel lechem vekali vecharmel kezayit mikkol echad veechad loke shalosh malkiyyot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 14)</small> "velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheshshelashtan ballavin chalukin ze mizze: 
Kol tevua shehishrisha kodem hakeravat haomer af al pi shello nigmera ella achar shekkarav mutteret baachila mishshekkarav haomer. utevua shehishrisha achar shekkarav haomer af al pi shehayta zerua kodem shekkarav haomer hare zo asura ad sheyyikkarev haomer shel shana habbaa. vedin ze bechol makom uvechol zeman min hattora: 
Tevua shehishrisha achar haomer uketzara vezara min hachittim bakkarka. veachar kach karav haomer habba vaadayin hachittim bakkarka. hare ellu safek im hittiran haomer keillu hayu munnachin bechad. o lo yattir otan mippene shebbatlu bakkarka. lefichach im likket mehem veachal eno loke. umakkin oto makkat mardut. vechen shibbolet shehevia shelish millifne haomer vaakarah ushetalah achar shekkarav haomer vehosifa hare zo safek im tihye asura mippene hattosefet ad sheyyavo haomer habba o lo tihye asura shehare hishrisha kodem haomer: 
Kile hakkerem ketzad. min mimmine tevua o mine yerakot shennizreu im haggefen. ben shezzara yisrael ben shezzara nachri. ben shealu mealehen. ben shennata haggefen betoch hayyarak. shenehem asurin baachila uvahanaya shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 9)</small> "pen tikdash hammelea hazzera asher tizra utevuat hakkarem". kelomar pen titrachek veteesor shenehem: 
Vehaochel kezayit mikkile hakkerem ben min hayyarak ben min haanavim loke min hattora. ushenehem mitztarfin ze im ze: 
Bamme devarim amurim shennizreu beeretz yisrael. aval bechutza laaretz kile hakkerem middivre sofrim. uvehilchot kilayim yitbaer e ze min asur bechile hakkerem vee ze min eno asur veheach yeesor umatay yeaser vee ze davar mekaddesh vee ze eno mekaddesh: 
Haarla ketzad. kol hannotea ilan maachol kol perot sheose oto ilan shalosh shanim mishshennata hare hen asurin baachila uvahanaa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 23)</small> "shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim lo yeachel". vechol haochel mehem kezayit loke min hattora: 
Bamme devarim amurim benotea beeretz yisrael shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 23)</small> "ki tavou el haaretz" vegomer. aval issur arla bechutza laaretz halacha lemoshe missinay shevvadday haarla bechutza laaretz asura usefekah muttar. uvehilchot maaser sheni yitbaer devarim haasurin mishshum arla udevarim hammuttarin: 
Sefek arla vechile hakkerem beeretz yisrael asur. besureya vehi aratzot shekkavash david muttar. ketzad. haya kerem vearla vaanavim nimkarot chutza lo. haya yarak zarua betocho veyarak nimkar chutza lo. shemma mimmennu hu ze shemma meacher. besureya muttar. uvechutz laaretz afillu raa haanavim yotzot mikkerem arla o yarak yotze min hakkerem lokeach mehen. vehu shello yire oto botzer min haarla o loket hayyarak beyado: 
Kerem shehu sefek arla o sefek kilayim beeretz yisrael asur uvesureya muttar. veen tzarich lomar bechutza laaretz: 
Chavit yayin hannimtzet temuna befardes shel arla asura bishtiyya umutteret bahanaya sheen haggannav gonev mimmakom vetomen bo. aval anavim hannimtzain temunim sham asurim shemma mishsham nilketu vehitznian sham: 
Nachri veyisrael shehayu shuttafin bintia im hitnu mittechillat hashshuttafut sheyyihye hannachri ochel shene arla veyisrael ochel shalosh shanim mishshene hetter keneged shene haarla hare ze muttar. veim lo hitnu mittechilla asur uvilvad shello yavou lecheshbon. ketzad. kegon sheyyachshov kamma perot achal hannachri bishne arla ad sheyyochal yisrael keneged otan happerot. im hitnu kaze asur shehare ze kemachalif perot arla: 
Yerae li sheen din neta revai noheg bechutza laaretz ella ochel perot shana reviit belo pidyon kelal shello amru ella haarla. vekal vachomer haddevarim uma sureya shehi chayyevet bemaasrot uvishviit middivrehem enah chayyevet beneta revai kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot maaser sheni. chutza laaretz lo kol shekken shello yihye neta revai noheg bah. aval beeretz yisrael noheg bah ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit. vehoru miktzat geonim shekkerem revai levaddo podin oto bechutza laaretz veachar kach yihye muttar baachila. veen ledavar ze ikkar: 
Perot shana reviit kullah asur leechol mehen beeretz yisrael ad sheyyippadu. uvehilchot maaser sheni yitbaer mishpete pidyonan vedin achilatan umeematay monin learla velirvai: 
Ketzad podin perot neta revai bazzeman hazze. achar sheosef otan mevarech. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al pidyon neta revai. veachar kach pode et kullan vaafillu bifruta achat veomer hare ellu peduyin bifruta zo umashlich otah peruta leyam hammelach o mechallelan al sheve peruta mipperot acherot. veomer hare kol happerot haellu mechullalin al chittim ellu o al seorim ellu vechayyotze bahen. vesoref otan kede shello yihyu takkala laacherim. veochel kol happerot: 
Horu miktzat haggeonim sheaf al pi sheppada perot shana reviit o chillelan asur leachlan ad shettikkanes shana chamishit. vedavar ze en lo ikkar. veyerae li shezzo shiggat horaa vehattaam lefi shekkatuv <small>(Vayikra 19 25)</small> "uvashshana hachamishit tochlu et piryo" veen inyan hakkatuv ella shebbashshana hachamishit tochlu piryo belo pidyon kechol chullin shebbaolam. veen rauy lachush lehoraa zo: 
Hattevel ketzad. kol ochel shehu chayyav lehaferish mimmennu teruma umaasrot kodem sheyyafrish mimmennu nikra tevel veasur leechol mimmennu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 15)</small> "velo yechallelu et kadshe bene yisrael et asher yarimu laAdonai". kelomar lo yinhagu bahen minhag chullin vaadayin kadashim sheatidin lehittarem lo huremu. vehaochel kezayit min hattevel kodem sheyyafrish mimmennu teruma gedola uterumat maaser chayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar velo yechallelu et kadshe bene yisrael vegomer vehissiu otam avon ashma: 
Aval haochel middavar shennittela mimmennu teruma gedola uterumat maaser vaadayin lo hifrish mimmennu maasrot vaafillu lo nishar bo ella maasar ani hare ze loke mishshum ochel tevel. veen bo mita sheen avon mita ella bitruma gedola uterumat maaser: 
Azhara laochel tevel shello huremu mimmennu maasrot bichlal shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha maasar degancha" vegomer. uvehilchot terumot umaasrot yitbaer eze davar chayyav bitruma uvemaasrot vee ze davar patur. vee ze davar hu chayyav min hattora vee zehu hachayyav middivre sofrim. vehaochel kezayit mittevel shel divrehem o mikkile hakkerem vearla shel chutza laaretz makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Hattevel vehechadash vehahekdesh usefiche sheviit vehakkilayim vehaarla mashkin hayyotzin mipperotehen asurim kemotan veen lokin alehen. chutz miyyayin veshemen shel arla veyayin shel kile hakkerem shellokin alehen kederech shellokin al hazzetim veal haanavim shellahen: 
Veyesh bekadashim issurin acherim bemaachalot vechullan shel tora hen. kegon issurin sheyyesh baachilat terumot uvikkurim vechalla umaaser sheni. veissurin sheyyesh bekadshe mizbeach kegon piggul venotar vetame. vechol echad mehen yitbaer bimkomo: 
Veshiur kol achila mehen kezayit ben lemalkot ben lecharet. uchevar bearnu issur chametz befesach vedinav behilchot chametz umatztza. aval issur achila beyom hakkippurim issur min bifne atzmo. vechen issur yotze miggefen al hannazir eno shave bakkol. ulefichach yitbaer issur kol echad mehen veshiuro vedinav bimkomo harauy lo:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 11:
Yayin shennitnassech leakkum asur bahanaya. vehashshote mimmennu kol shehu loke min hattora. vechen haochel kol shehu mittikrovet akkum mibbasar o mipperot afillu mayim umelach haochel mehen kol shehu loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 38)</small> "asher chelev zevachemo yochelu yishtu yen nesicham yakumu" vegomer: 
Yayin shennitnassech lah kezevach shekkarev lah vechevan sheissur ze mishshum akkum hu en lo shiur shenneemar baavodat kochavim umazzalot <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem": 
Yen haakkum sheen anu yodin im nitnassech o lo nitnassech vehu hannikra setam yenam asur bahanaa kemo yayin shennitnassech. vedavar ze miggezerot sofrim hu. vehashshote missetam yenam reviit makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Vechol yayin sheyyigga bo haakkum hare ze asur shemma nissech oto shemmachshevet haakkum laavodat kochavim. ha lamadta sheyyen yisrael shennaga bo haakkum dino kistam yenam shehu asur bahanaya: 
Akkum shennaga beyayin shello bechavvana vechen tinok akkum shennaga beyayin asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaya. hallokeach avadim min haakkum umalu vetavlu miyyad en menassechin veyayin shennagu bo muttar bishtiyya veaf al pi sheadayin lo nahagu bedate yisrael velo paska akkum mippihem: 
Bene hashshefachot haakkum shennoldu birshut yisrael umalu vaadayin lo tavlu haggedolim osrin hayyayin kesheyyiggeu bo vehakketannim enan osrin: 
Ger toshav vehu shekkibbel alav sheva mitzvot kemo shebbearnu yeno asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaya. umeyachadin etzlo yayin veen mafkidin etzlo yayin. vechen kol akkum sheeno oved akkum kegon ellu hayyishmeelim yenan asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaya. vechen horu kol haggeonim. aval otam haovdim akkum setam yenam asur bahanaya: 
Kol makom shenneemar beinyan ze shehayyayin asur im haya akkum shenneesar hayyayin biglalo oved akkum hare hu asur bahanaya. veim eno oved akkum hare hu asur bishtiyya bilvad. vechol makom shenneemar akkum setam hare ze oved akkum: 
En mitnassech leakkum ella yayin sherauy lehakeriv al gabbe hammizbeach umippene ze kesheggazru al setam yenam vegazru al kol yayin sheyyigga bo sheyyihye asur bahanaya lo gazru ella al hayyayin harauy lehitnassech. lefichach yayin mevushshal shel yisrael shennaga bo haakkum eno asur umuttar lishtot im haakkum bechos echad. aval yayin mazug veyayin shehitchil lehachamitz veefshar sheyyishte im naga bo neesar: 
Horu geone hammaarav sheim nitarev beyen yisrael meat devash o meat seor hoil veeno rauy lammizbeach hare hu kimvushshal o keshechar veeno mitnassech umuttar lishtoto im haakkum: 
Meematay yeaser yen haakkum mishsheyyidroch veyimmashech hayyayin af al pi shello yarad labbor ella adayin hu baggat hare ze asur. lefichach en dorchin im haakkum baggat shemma yigga beyado vinassech. vaafillu haya kafut. veen lokchin mimmennu gat derucha veaf al pi sheadayin hayyayin meorav im hachartzannim vezaggin velo yarad labbor: 
Akkum sheddarach hayyayin velo naga bo vahare yisrael omed al gabbav veyisrael hu shekkenaso bechavit hare ze asur bishtiyya: 
Hachometz shel akkum asur bahanaya mippene shennaasa yen nesech kodem sheyyachmitz. akkum shehaya dores anavim bechavit af al pi shehayyayin tzaf al gabbe yadav en choshshin mishshum yen nesech. haya ochel min hassallim vehotir kisa uchesatayim uzerakan baggat af al pi shehayyayin miggitto al haanavim en ose yen nesech: 
Hachartzannim vehazzaggin shel akkum asurim kol 12 chodesh. uleachar 12 chodesh kevar yavshu velo nishara bahen lachluchit umuttarin baachila. vechen shemarim shel yayin sheyyavshu leachar shenem asar chodesh muttarin shehare lo nishar bahen reach yayin vahare hen keafar vechaadama:
