Begadim ellu shemmekannechin bahen tzerichin sheyyihyu shel pishtan shachakim ulevanim vehem hannikraim edim beinyan ze. vehabbeged shemmekanneach bo hu nikra ed shello. vehabbeged shemmekannachat hi bo nikra ed shellah:

Hatztzenuot en meshammeshot ella ad sheyyivdeku atzman techilla kodem tashmish. veishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh ad shettivdok. lefichach hi meshammeshet bishne edim echad lifne hattashmish veechad leachar hattashmish. aval ishsha sheyyesh lah veset enah tzericha ed lifne tashmish ella mishshum tzeniut bilvad. aval achar tashmish hakkol tzerichin shene edim echad lo veechad lah afillu meubberet umenika uzekena. uketanna lo teshammesh ella bishne edim echad lo veechad lah. aval betula veyoshevet al dam tohar enah tzericha edim shehare haddam shotet mimmenna:

Hameshammesh mittato peamim rabbot enan tzerichin livdok shene haedim shellahen al kol bia uvia. ella mekanneach hu beed shello vehi beed shellah achar kol bia uvia shel kol hallayla ulemachar yivdeku haedim. nimtza haddam al ed shellah o al ed shello hare zo temea. shimmesha mittatah vekinnecha atzmah veavad haed hare zo lo teshammesh paam sheniyya ad shettivdok beed acher techilla. shemma dam haya al haed sheavad:
Hinnicha haed tachat hakkar o tachat hakkeset venimtza alav dam. im mashuch temea shechezkato min hakkinnuach. veim haya agol tehora sheen ze ella dam maacholet shenneherga tachat hakkar:

Kinnecha atzmah beed habbaduk lah vetachato birechah ulemachar nimtza alav dam hare zo temea. veen omrim shemma keshettacha otah birechah neherga maacholet. kinnecha atzmah beed sheeno baduk lah velo yada im haya alav dam kodem shettekanneach bo o lo haya. nimtza alav dam im haya haddam kigris veod hare zo nidda. haya pachot mikken tehora sheeno ella min hamaacholet:

Mi sheraata dam bishat tashmish hare zo mutteret leshammesh keshettithar paam sheniyya. raata dam befaam sheniyya meshammeshet paam shelishit. raata dam bashshelishit hare zo asura leshammesh im baal ze leolam. bamme devarim amurim beshello haya sham davar litlot bo. aval im shimmesha samuch levistah tola bavveset. hayta bah makka tola bammakka. veim haya dam makkatah meshunne middam shettire beet hattashmish enah tola bammakka. veneemenet ishsha lomar makka yesh li betoch hammakor shemmimmenna haddam yotze vetihye mutteret levalah. veaf al pi sheddam yotze min hammakor bishat tashmish:

Mi sheraata dam bishat tashmish paam rishona usheniyya ushelishit veen sham davar litlot bo hare zo titgaresh umutteret lehinnase lesheni. nisset lesheni veraata dam kach bishat tashmish shalosh peamim hare zo titgaresh vetinnase lishlishi. nisset lishlishi veraata dam kach bishat tashmish shalosh peamim hare zo titgaresh vaasura lehinnase ad shettavri mecholi ze:

Ketzad bodeket atzmah leda im nirpet o lo nirpet. mevia shefoferet shel avar ufiha ratzuf letochah umachneset hashshefoferet ad makom shehi yechola. umachneset betoch hashshefoferet michchol umoch munnach al rosho vedofeket oto ad sheyyaggia hammoch letzavvar harechem umotzia hammoch. im nimtza dam al rosh hammoch beyadua shehaddam shehi roa bishat tashmish min hammakor. veim lo nimtza al hammoch kelum beyadua shehaddam sheroa middochak hatztzedadin utehora hi umutteret lehinnase laacherim kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 5: Haisha mittammet beones ben lenidda ben lezivut. ketzad. kegon shekkaftza mimmakom lemakom. o raata behema o chayya o of mitassekin ze im ze vechamda veraata dam. vechen kol kayyotze baze hoil veraata dam mikkol makom nitmet umetammea bechol shehu. afillu raata dam tippa kechardal hare zo kemi shezzav mimmenna damim harebe:

Kol hannashim mittammeot babbayit hachitzon. veaf al pi shello yatza haddam lachutz ella neekar min harechem velo shatat hoil veyatza mibben hashshinnayim hare zo temea veaf al pi sheadayin haddam bivsarah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 19)</small> "dam yihye zovah bivsarah". vead hechan hu ben hashshinnayim ad makom sheyyaggia elav haevar bishat gemar bia. uven hashshinnayim atzmo kilfanim:

Mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha. harechem shennotzar bo havvalad hu hannikra makor. vehu sheddam nidda vezava yotze mimmennu. vekorin oto cheder lefi shehu lifnay velifnim. vetzavvar harechem kullo vehu hammakom haaroch shemmitkkabbetz rosho bishat haibbur kede shello yippol havvalad veniftach harebe bishat leda korin oto perozdor kelomar shehu bet shaar larechem:

Uvishat gemar bia haevar nichnas bifrozdor veeno maggia ad rosho shemmibbifnim ella rachok mimmennu meat lefi haetzbaot. ulemala min hacheder umin happerozdor ben cheder lifrozdor hu hammakom sheyyesh bo shete betzim shel ishsha. vehashshevilim shebbahen mitbashshelet shichvat zera shellah makom ze hu hannikra aliyya. uchemo nekev patuach min haaliyya legag happerozdor venekev ze korin oto lul. vehaevar nichnas lifnim min hallul bishat gemar bia:

Dam habba min hacheder kullo tame chutz middam tohar shehattora tiharattu vedam koshi kemo sheyyitbaer. vedam haaliyya kullo tahor shehu kemo dam makka shebbammeayim o bakkaved o bechuleya vechayyotze bahen. vedam hannimtza bapperozdor im nimtza min hallul ulefanim hare ze tame shechezkato min hacheder. vechayyavin alav al biat mikdash vesorfin alav teruma vekadashim veen omrim shemma min haaliyya yarad derech hannekev. sherov haddamim hannimtzain kan min hacheder. nimtza haddam bapperozdor chutz lannekev hare tumato besafek shemma min hacheder ba o min haaliyya shatat derech hallul. lefichach en sorfin alav teruma vekadashim veen chayyavin alav al biat hammikdash:

Lo kol mashke habba min hacheder metamme ella haddam bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 19)</small> "dam yihye zovah". lefichach im shatat min harechem loven o mashke yarok af al pi shessemichato kedam hoil veen marav mare dam hare ze tahor:
Vachamishsha damim temeim baishsha vehashshear tehorin. veellu hen. haadom. vehashshachor. uchekeren karkom. uchememe adama. ucheyayin hammazug:

Haadom ketzad hu eno. keammud sheyyatza rishon middam hakkaza shel bene adam, noten haddam bechos umakkif lo veroehu. vehashshachor keen haddeyo hayyavesh. kekeren karkom ketzad. yavi karkom lach begush adama shealav velokeach min habbarur shebbo hakkane haemtzai shello shekkullo kemo kane hu uvechol echad veechad shelosha kanim uvechol kane shelosha alim umakkif haddam leale haemtzai shebbakkane haemtzai veroe bo. kememe adama ketzad. yavi adama mibbikat sichne vechayyotze bah shehi adumma venoten aleha mayim bichli ad sheyyaale hammayim al heafar kiklippat hashshum. veen shiur lammayim velo leafar. umeakkeran bichli umeshaer bahen lishato uvimkomo keshehen achurin. veim tzallu chozer umeakkeran:

Arbaa marot hallalu im haya mare haddam kemare kol echad mehen o amok mehen hare ze tame. haya diha mimmennu hare ze tahor. ketzad. haya haddam shachor yeter mikkidyo hayyavesh temea. haya pachot mimmennu kegon shehaya marehu keen hazzayit hashshachor o keen hazzefet o keen haorev hare ze tahor. vechen bishar hashshelosha marot:

Keyayin hammazug ketzad. chelek echad yayin min hayyayin hashsharoni shel eretz yisrael chay vechadash ushene chalakim mayim. haya mare haddam amok mimmennu o diha mimmennu hare ze tahor ad sheyyihye kemezeg ze bilvad. veneemenet ishsha lomar kemare ze raiti veibbadtiv vehechacham metamme lah o metaher:

Ketzad makkif veroe. lokeach hammatlit sheyyesh bah haddam beyado umabbit bo uvaddeyo. o beale shel karkom. o bedam hakkaza shebbakkos. o bememe adama. o bemezeg shebbakkos. veorech lah kefi ma sheenav root umetamme o metaher. veeno mabbit bazzechuchit shel kos mibbachutz ella bammashke shebbakkos. veyihye hakkos rachav mishkalo mane umachazik shene login kede shettikkanes bo haora velo yihye afel:

En bodkin haddam ella al gabbe matlit levana uvachamma. veose tzel beyado al haddam vehu omed bachamma kede sheyyire eno kemot shehi. velo kol haroe tzarich lechol ellu haddevarim bechol et sheyyire ella teviut ayin yesh lechacham bedamim. uveet sheyyire miyyad yetamme o yetaher. veim nistappek lo bemare min hammarot tzarich lehakkif velaaroch lidyo o ledam hakkaza o lishar hammarot:
Hammappelet chaticha af al pi shehi adumma im yesh immah dam temea veim lav tehora vaafillu nikrea hachaticha venimtzet melea dam hare zo tehora sheen ze dam nidda ella dam chaticha:

Hippila chaticha kerua vedam agur betochah temea. hippila kemin kelippa kemin saara kemin afar kemo yavchushin im haya mare devarim ellu adom tattil lemayim poshrin. im nimmochu hare zo temea sheddam hu vekafa vechol haroa dam yavesh temea. veim shahu befoshrin meet leet veachar kach nimmochu hare zo safek temea. lo nimmochu meet leet hare ellu mimmakka utehora hi:
Hippila kemin chagavim kemin dagim shekatzim uremasim im yesh immahen dam temea veim lav tehora:

Haishsha shehichnisa shefoferet bapperozdor veraata haddam betoch hashshefoferet tehora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 19)</small> "dam yihye zovah bivsarah" ad shettire bivsarah kederech shehannashim root. veen derech haishsha lirot bishfoferet:

Haishsha shehishtina mayim veyatza dam im me raglayim. ben shehishtina vehi omedet ben shehishtina vehi yoshevet hare zo tehora. vaafillu hirgish gufah venizdazea enah chosheshet sheharegashat me raglayim hi zo sheen me raglayim min hacheder vedam ze dam makka hu bachalcholet o bakkuleya:

Dam betulim tahor hu veeno lo dam nidda velo dam ziva sheeno min hammakor ella kemo dam chabbura. vechetzad din habbetula bedamim. im nisset ketanna ben lo raata dam miyyameha ben sheraata dam bevet aviha hare zo mutteret levalah ad shettichye hammakka shekkol dam shettire mechamat hammakka hu. veim raata dam achar shettichye hammakka hare zo nidda:

Nisset keshehi naara im lo raata miyyameha dam hare zo mutteret levalah arbaa yamim bayyom uvallayla af al pi shehaddam shotet vehu shello chayta hammakka. veim raata dam bevet aviha veachar kach nisset en lo lavo aleha ella beila rishona uforesh veyihye dam betulim ze keillu hi techillat nidda. uvogeret shello raata miyyameha notnin lah kol layla harishon:
Arbaa lelot shennotnin lenaara shello raata dam af al pi shehen beserugin boel layla harishon umamtin afillu shene chodashim o shelosha uvoel layla sheni. vehu shello chayta hammakka:
Vechen ketanna shennotnin lah ad shettichye hammakka afillu lo chayta shana hare ze boel kol hashshana ben beserugin ben beyom achar yom:

Ketanna shennisset venaaset naara tachat balah vaadayin haddam shotet mechamat hammakka kol beilot shebbaal keshehi ketanna nechshavot lo kelayla echad umashlimin lo kol arbaa yamim bime hannaarut. vaafillu hayu hashshelosha yamim shennotnin lo bime hannaarut beserugin uvaal bechol shene chodashim layla echad hare ze muttar vehu shello chayta hammakka:

Ketzad yodin im chayta hammakka o lo chayta. hayta roa haddam beet shettaamod ucheshetteshev lo tire uveet shetteshev al hakkarka tire veim teshev al gabbe karim uchesatot lo tire adayin lo chayta hammakka. pasak haddam velo raata kelal ben omedet ben yoshevet al hakkar kevar chayta hammakka. vechen im lo pasak kelal ella tire haddam vaafillu keshehi yoshevet al hakkarim vehakkesatot en ze dam makka ella dam nidda:
Hayta roa beet tashmish hare ze mechamat hammakka. shimmesha mittatah velo raata dam veachar kach raata dam shello mechamat tashmish hare ze dam nidda:

Habboel betula velo yatza mimmenna dam vechazar uvealah veyatza dam afillu hayta ketanna hare ze dam nidda sheillu haya dam betulim haya ba battechilla. habboel pechuta mibbat shalosh veyatza dam hare ze dam betulim:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 6: Dam hannidda vedam hazzava vedam hakkoshi vedam yoledet vedam tohar shel yoledet kullo dam echad hu umin hammakor hu ba. umaayan echad hu. uvizmannim bilvad hu sheyyishtanne dino vetihye roa dam zo tehora. vezo nidda. vezo zava:

Ketzad. keshettire haishsha dam techilla o keshettire bishat vestah vehu haet shekkava leniddatah hare zo nidda kol shivat hayyamim. ben raata kol shiva ben shello raata ella tippa rishona bilvad. raata dam bayyom hashshemini hare ze dam ziva mippene shehu belo et niddatah:
Vechen kol dam shettire betoch hayyamim shebben veset nidda leveset nidda hare hu dam ziva. vahalacha lemoshe missinay sheen ben zeman nidda lizman nidda ella achad asar yom bilvad:

Kol shivat hayyamim shennikbea lah veset bitchillatan hen hannikrain yeme niddatah. ben raata bahen dam ben lo raata bahen dam. umippene ma nikrain yeme nidda mippene shehen reuyin lenidda. vechol dam shettire bahem dam nidda yechashev:

Vechol achad asar yom sheachar hashshiva hen hannikrain yeme zivatah. ben raata bahen dam ben lo raata. velamma nikrain yeme ziva mippene shehen reuyin leziva. vechol dam shettire bahen dam ziva yechashev. vehizzaher bishne shemot ellu shehen yeme niddatah vime zivatah:

Kol yeme haishsha miyyom sheyyikkava lah veset ad shettamut o ad sheyyeaker havveset leyom acher tispor leolam shiva mittechillat yom havveset veacharehen achad asar [veacharehen] shiva veacharehen achad asar. vetizzaher bamminyan kede shetteda beet shettire dam im bime nidda raata o bime ziva. shekkol yameha shel ishsha kach hen shiva yeme nidda veachad asar yeme ziva. ella im ken hifsika halleda kemo sheyyitbaer:

Ishsha sheraata dam bime zivatah yom echad bilvad o shene yamim ze achar ze nikret zava ketanna venikret shomeret yom keneged yom. veim raata shelosha yamim ze achar ze hare zo zava gemura vehi hannikret zava gedola venikret zava setam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 25)</small> "veishsha ki yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim" miut yamim shenayim rabbim shelosha:

En ben zava gedola lezava ketanna ella sefirat shiva vahavaat karban. shezzava gedola tzericha lispor shiva yamim nekiyyim vezava ketanna enah soferet ella yom echad bilvad. vezava gedola mevia karban keshettithar [vezava ketanna enah mevia karban keshettithar]. aval leinyan tuma veissur bia shetehen shavot:

Ketzad. raata dam bime zivatah. ben sheraata bitchillat hallayla ben sheraata besof hayyom. hare oto hayyom kullo tame ucheillu lo pasak haddam meet sheraata ad sheshshaka hachamma umeshammeret kol hallayla. veim lo raata kelum ballayla mashkemet lemachar vetovelet achar shettanetz hachamma umeshammeret kol hayyom. im lo raata kelum hare ze yom echad tahor keneged hayyom hattame vahare hi mutteret levalah laerev:

Raata dam gam bayyom hashsheni ben belelo ben beyomo achar shettavla hare hayyom hashsheni tame umeshammeret kol lel shelishi. im lo raata mashkemet lemachar vetovelet achar shettanetz hachamma umeshammeret kol hayyom. im lo raata kelum hare ze yom echad tahor keneged shene yamim hattemeim umutteret levalah laerev:

Raata dam gam bashshelishi ben beyomo ben belelo hare zo zava gedola utzericha lispor shiva yamim tehorim belo dam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 28)</small> "vesafra lah shivat yamim" vegomer vetovelet bayyom hashshevii achar hanetz hachamma vahare hi mutteret levalah laerev. uvayyom hashshemini mevia karbanah shene torim o shene bene yona:
Zava ketanna shettavla ballayla shel yom hashshimmur o zava gedola shettavla belel shevii keillu lo tavla vahare hi kenidda shettavla betoch shiva:

Habba al zava gedola beyom shevii shel sefira achar shettavla o al zava ketanna beyom hashshimmur achar shettavla patur min hakkaret. kevan shettavla bazzeman harauy litvilatah tehora. uleishsha zo yihye lah tarbut raa shehare beilatah umaggaah teluyin:

Ketzad hen teluyin. im nishlam hayyom achar hattevila velo raata dam hare kol shennaga bo achar tevilatah tahor uveilatah achar hattevila en chayyavin aleha kelum. veim raata dam beyom ze achar shettavla nimtzet zava lemafrea vechol shennaga bo lemafrea tame. vehi uvoalah chayyavin bekarban. ulefichach hi asura levalah ad laerev shello tavi atzmah lide safek:
Zava shessafra sheshet yamim nekiyyim. uvashshevii raata dam afillu samuch lishkiat hachamma soteret hakkol vechozeret limnot meachar hayyom hattame shiva yamim nekiyyim:

Palta shichvat zera betoch yeme hassefira soteret yom echad mippene shehu kezav sheraa keri shessoter yom echad. raata dam baasiri mime zivatah uveachad asar uvishtem asar af al pi sheraata shelosha yamim ze achar ze enah zava gedola. ella yatzat mizzivut ketanna lenidda sheyyom shenem asar matchelet niddatah veharoa bime niddatah enah zava kemo shebbearnu:

Uma hu ze shekkatuv battora <small>(Vayikra 15 25)</small> "o ki tazuv al niddatah". sheim raata shelosha yamim samuch leniddatah hare zo zava. kegon sheraata bashshemini leniddatah uvatteshii uvaasiri shehen rishon vesheni ushelishi mehaachad asar yom shehen yeme zivatah. raata dam bay mime zivatah vetavla laerev shehu lel 12 veshimmesha mittatah af al pi shehi temea uvoalah tame veosin mishkav umoshav enam chayyavim karet mippene sheen yom 12 mitztaref leyom 11 laasot zava. hoila lah tevilat lel ze lehatztzilah min hakkarban:

Tavla beyom 12 achar shettanetz hachamma hare zo asura levalah ad laerev kedin kol zava ketanna. veim avar uvealah shenehen peturin mikkelum. vaafillu raata dam achar shebba aleha beyom 12 en bechach kelum shezze dam nidda hu veeno mitztaref layyom shellefanav:

Raata dam besof shevii leniddatah ben hashshemashot veraata batteshii uvaasiri hare zo sefek zava. shemma reiyya rishona belel shemini hayta venimtzet sheraata shelosha yamim ze achar ze mittechillat yeme zivatah. vechen im raata dam batteshii uvaasiri mime zivatah veraata besof yom achad asar ben hashshemashot hare zo sefek zava. shemma reiyya acharona beyom achad asar hayta vahare raata shelosha yamim ze achar ze bime zivatah:

Nidda shebbadka atzmah betoch yeme niddatah umatza sheppasak haddam vaafillu pasak besheni leniddatah veshagga o hezida velo badka ad leachar niddatah yamim rabbim ucheshebbadka matza tuma. en omrim shemma kol otan hayyamim hayta temea vetihye zava ella kol otan hayyamim shello badka bechezkat tohora. badka atzmah umatza temea. afillu badka bashshevii leniddatah uven hashshemashot lo badka atzmah kede lifrosh mittumat nidda ella himtina yamim veachar kach badka umatzat tehora hare zo sefek zava. veim matza temea hare zo zava vaddait shekkevan shebbattechilla matza temea ulevassof temea hare zo bechezkat shello pasak. veyom rishon shel nidda af al pi shemmatza bo tehora hare zo kemi shemmatza temea. sheyyom rishon kullo huchzak hammaayan patuach:
Zava shebbadka atzmah barishon mime hassefira umatza tahor velo badka ad yom shevii umatza tahor hare zo bechezkat tohora ucheillu badka kol shiva umatza tahor:

Vechen im badka beyom rishon mime hassefira umatza tahor uvayyom hashshemini umatza tahor hare zo bechezkat tohora. badka beyom shelishi lezivatah umatza sheppasak haddam velo badka beyom rishon mime hassefira uvashshevii badka umatza tahor hare zo bechezkat tohora. vehu haddin lezav bechol ellu habbedikot shehu tahor vealu lo yeme sefira:

Kol ishsha shehi sefek nidda sefek zava tzericha leshev shivat yamim nekiyyim missafek vetovelet belel shemini veachar kach tihye mutteret levalah. umevia karban zava veeno neechol kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 7: Meuveret shehitchila lehitztaer vaachazuha chevle leda vehitchil haddam latzet kodem shetteled oto haddam hu hannikra dam hakkoshi. veheach dino. im ba bime niddatah hare hu dam nidda vahare zo temea nidda. veim ba bime zivatah hare zo tehora shenneemar bezava <small>(Vayikra 15 19)</small> "dam yihye zovah bivsarah". mippi hashshemua lamdu zovah mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad. uvilvad shetteled valad chay. aval im hippila en koshi linfalim. afillu haya haddam shotet veyored im hachavalim vehatztzaar 14 yom kodem shetteled hare ze dam koshi vetahor. aval im hitchil haddam kodem halleda betv yom o yeter hare ze dam ziva vahare hi yoledet bezov:

Bamme devarim amurim beshello pasku hatztzirim vehachavalim vehatztzaar ella mitkashsha veholechet ad sheyyalda. aval im raata dam shelosha yamim o yeter bime zivatah betzaar vachavalim ufasak lah hatztzaar veravach lah min hachavalim achar hashshelosha yamim veamda benachat 24 shaot o yeter af al pi shello pasak haddam veaf al pi shechazar hatztzaar vehachavalim achar 24 shaot hare zo zava. sheillu haya haddam mechamat havvalad lo pasak hatztzaar velo hachavalim. veim yalda achare chen hare zo yoledet bezov:

Raata yom echad belo tzaar ushenayim bekoshi veyalda. o shenayim belo tzaar veyom echad bekoshi veyalda. o yom bekoshi veyom belo tzaar veyom bekoshi veyalda enah yoledet bezov. aval im raata yom echad bekoshi ushenayim belo tzaar veyalda. o shenayim bekoshi veechad belo tzaar veyalda. o yom belo tzaar veyom bekoshi veyom belo tzaar veyalda hare zo yoledet bezov. ze hakkelal koshi samuch lalleda en zo yoledet bezov. shofi samuch lalleda hare zo yoledet bezov:

Chal shelishi liriyyatah lihyot beyom halleda afillu kol hayyom kullo beshofi en zo yoledet bezov. shehare yom halleda samuch lakkoshi. raata shene yamim uvashshelishi hippila veen yadua ma hippila hare zo sefek yoledet usefek zava:

Ketzad din yoledet bezov. tzericha leshev shiva yamim nekiyyim vetovelet laerev. veachar kach tihye mutteret levalah veachar kach yihye lah dam tohar umevia karban zava vekarban yoledet. lefichach im yalda zachar afillu pasak haddam beyom halleda soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim vetovelet. veim yalda nekeva vesafra shiva nekiyyim veshalmu im 14 shel leda o leacharehen hare zo tovelet umutteret levalah. veim shalmu yeme hassefira betoch 14 hare zo asura levalah ad lel 15:

Ketzad. hare sheraata dam shelosha vesafra shivat yamim nekiyyim hare asara. vaadayin hi asura levalah ad lel 15. shekkol 14 hi kenidda. velamma en matzrichin et hayyoledet bezov lisfirat shiva achar shiva shel zachar veachar 14 shel nekeva. mippene sheyyeme ledatah vime niddatah sheenah roa bahen olin lah lisfirat shiva kemo sheyyitbaer:

Yoledet bezov shello pasak damah en lah dam tohar. ella kol dam shettire kedam ziva hu. aval im safra shivat yamim nekiyyim veshalmu 14 shel nekeva vetavla veachar kach raata dam betoch arbaim shel zachar ushemonim shel nekeva hare ze dam tohar:

Safra shiva yamim nekiyyim velo tavla veachar kach raata dam hare zo tovelet umutteret levalah miyyad. shekkol yeme tohar enan reuyot lo lenidda velo leziva. aval atzmo shel dam tame umetamme kedin dam hannidda ad shettitbol:

Hayyoledet nekeva veachar 14 shellah nitabbera vehitchil dam hakkoshi lavo lah betoch shemonim hare hu dam tohar. af al pi sheen koshi linfalim shekkol damim shettire betoch yeme tohar tahor hu ad shettappil havvalad. ucheshettappil tihye temea leda. im hippila zachar tumat zachar veim hippila nekeva tumat nekeva. umona yeme tuma vime melot mivvalad sheni. afillu hayu teomim vehippila hayyom echad vehippila haacher afillu achar kamma yamim mona lashsheni yeme tuma vime melot:

Zava sheppasak zovah vehitchila limnot shivat yamim nekiyyim uva lah dam koshi betoch yamim nekiyyim eno soter. vime hakkoshi olim leminyan shiva. vechen im yalda beshiva yamim nekiyyim en halleda soteret. vime halleda olin lah leminyan shiva af al pi shehi temea bahen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 28)</small> "veim tahara mizzovah" kevan shettahara mizzovah af al pi shehi temea tuma acheret kegon tumat leda o tumat nidda o tumat tzaraat hare zo soferet bahen. veen tumot ellu vechayyotze bahen sotrin hassefira:

Yeme ledatah vime niddatah im lo raata bahen dam hare ellu olin lah lisfirat shivat yamim nekiyyim veim raata bahen dam en olin lah yeme hariyya velo sotrin kol hayyamim. ella mashlemet al hayyamim shessafra kesheyyifsok haddam. sheen soter hakkol ella reiyya shel zov aval ellu sotrin yoman bilvad:

Meachar shettavin kol haikkarim shebbearnu. yitbaer lecha ma sheamru chachamim sheefshar shettire haishsha dam min hammakor yom achar yom mea vearbaa asar yom velo tihye zava. ketzad. shenayim lifne niddatah veshiva yeme niddatah ushenayim leachar yeme niddatah. vearbaa asar koshi. ushemonim shel nekeva. veshiva yeme nidda. ushenayim achar yeme nidda. ha lamadta shekkol dam shettire haishsha achar yom melot hu techillat niddatah veen mashgichin al vesatot shemmikkodem. lefichach haroa dam besof yom melot ben hashshemashot hare zo sefek nidda shemma ballayla raata haddam shehu techillat yeme niddatah:

Kevar bearnu shehannidda sheraata dam kol shiva mutteret leshammesh belel shemini achar shettitbol. vezava ketanna meshammeret yom echad tahor vetovelet umutteret leshammesh laerev. vezava gedola soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim vetovelet umutteret leshammesh belel shemini. veen ben zeman nidda lenidda ella achad asar yom bilvad. uveotan haachad asar tihye zava ketanna o gedola:

Umeachar shettihye zocher kol ellu haikkarim yitbaer lecha ze sheamru chachamim. haishsha shehuchzeka kol yameha yom tire dam veyom lo tire battechilla meshammeshet belel shemini uveyom shemini shehu yom echad achar yeme niddatah. umeshammeshet bechol 18 yom arbaa lelot bilvad. veenah yechola leshammesh bayyamim hattehorim shehayyom hattahor hu shomer layyom hattame. lefichach im hayta roa haddam bechol yom tame mittechillat hallayla enah meshammeshet ella bashshemini bilvad shehu yom echad achar yeme niddatah:
Hayta roa shene yamim temein ushene yamim tehorim meshammeshet bashshemini uvashshenem asar uvachamishsha asar uvaesrim:

Hayta roa shelosha yamim temein ushelosha tehorin meshammeshet shene yamim mehashshelosha hattehorin sheachar yeme niddatah. shehaechad mehen shamur lashshenayim hattemein hassemuchin leniddatah. veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam shehare huchzeka zava gedola veen lah shivat yamim nekiyyim:
Hayta roa arbaa yamim temeim vearbaa yamim tehorin meshammeshet yom echad sheachar niddatah veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam:
Hayta roa chamishsha yamim temeim vachamishsha yamim tehorim. meshammeshet hashshelosha hassemuchim leniddatah veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam:
Hayta roa shishsha yamim temein veshishsha yamim tehorin meshammeshet bachamishsha yamim hassemuchim leniddatah techilla veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam:
